tei:body.tei:div:
(ri sabod rig pa'i skor gyi rtsom yig thor bu/tharayulaphunatshogasatsheringagisabartsams/
bod rig pa'i skor gyi rtsom yig thor bu/shar yul phun tshogs che ring gis brtsams/bod ljongasa'idamangasadaposkrunakhang /
rnganabakazlod cangabakargya bod mi rigs kyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dang bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med cig yin pa'i skor/ ji ༷ (1)bod kyi gna' rabs kyi yul srol bzang po kha btags sam mjal dar gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (38)bon gyi bstan pa dar rgud ji ltar byung ba'i skor mdor tsam brjod pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (48)khyung po steng chen khyung dkar g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling / ༷ ༷ (72)'jig rten na grags che ba'i phrang nag gi gdan sa rtse drug dgon skor/ ༷ ༷ (83)bod yig gi 'byung tshul skor rags tsam gleng ba/ (99)lha sa'i dar po che ba'i yi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ ༷ ༷ ( 111)nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi kha 'phral dang kha 'phral la ngo rgol byed pa'i 'thab rtsod rwa stag 'gal ba'i skor gleng ba/ (119)ston pa gshen rab kyi 'khrungs yul rtag gzigs 'ol mo lung rings dang stag gzig ces pa'i go don skor/ ( 147)bon gyi bstan pa'i 'byung gnas zhang zhung gi skor/ ( 155)bod ces pa'i ming ji ltar thob pa'i skor/ ༷ ༷ ( 161)ya thog bon gyi ston pa rnams kyi gdung rgyud dang bon zhes pa'i go don skor/ ༷ ༷ ( 165)
rgya bod mi rigs kyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dang bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med cig yin pa'i skor/rang re'i rlabs chen mes rgyal ni mi rigs mang ba dang / gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig yin/bod ni mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med cig yin la/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyis lo ngo stong phrag 'ga' zhig ring mi rigs gzhan dang mnyam du mes rgyal gsar skrun byed pa'i bya gzhag nang rang nyid kyi shes rab dang /nus shugs ci yod legs skyes su phul yod/ lhag par du rgya bod spun zla mi rigs dbar chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs kyi thad mdza' brtse dang sha rus kyi 'brel ba yun ring gting zab yod pa ni 'dzam gling yongs su grags che ba zhig red/ rgya nag chos 'byung nang du bon ston la'o cun zhes 'khod par gzhigs na/ gri gum btsan po'i sras bya khri'i dus su rgya nag gi ta'o ca'o zhes pa'i gdod ma'i chos lugs de bod du 'khur nas 'khyar bon dar ba min nam snyam/ 'di ltar 'dod na han rgyal rabs kyi dus nas rgya bod mi rigs dbar rig gnas kyi 'brel ba zab mo zhig yod pa gsal por mthong / de rjes gnam ri srong btsan dus su rgya nag gi sman rtsis/ bod du dar ba las/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa dang rtsis rig gong du 'phel bar nus pa nges 1
can zhig thon yod/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su thang khra'o ni shes rig dar rgyas che zhing / stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa'i rgyal khab cig yin la/ thang tha'e tsung gi mtshan snyan ni 'dzam gling phyogs bzhi kun tu grags che bas/ bod shing rta ( spyi lo 634)lor/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos thang khra'o la 'tshams 'dri zhu bar pho nya ched du mngags/ de ni rgya bod mi rigs dngos su 'brel ba tshugs pa zhig mtshon pas rang cag rnams kyis dran gso byed 'os pa zhig los yin/ thang tha'e tsung nas kyang de 'phral h+phang bhā zhwa yis gtsos 'tshams 'dri tshogs pa zhig mngags pa de 'phrin yig skyel ma dang bcas bod du 'byor/ srong btsan sgam pos thang khra'o yi pho nya rnams la rgya che gzab rgyas kyi bsu ba dang sne len sogs mdzad pa smos ci/ slar yang rgya bza' kong jo slong bar pho nya mngags/ thang bod gnyen sgrig thad phan tshun mthun min tsam byung yod mod/ mthar btsan po'i bka' bzhin blon po mgar gyis gser gyi dong tse bdun dang / gser phye bre gang / rin po che baiḍūr+ya'i khrab la pad+ma ra ga'i phra yis brgyan pa gcig sogs rin chen dngos rdzas grangs las 'das pa bsnams/ rta pa brgya'i 'khor dang bcas bod me sprel ( spyi lo 636)lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal 'dzoms par rgya nag tu chas/ bod lcags glang ( spyi lo 641 )lo'i gza' skar mchog tu dge ba'i nyin thang tha'e tsung gi tsha mo kun shing kong jo sku 'khor dang / bod blon rnams bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ dgung lo bcu drug tu son pa'i kun shin kong jo ni lta bas mi ngom pa/ bzhin bzang mchog gyur ma/ sku mdog sngo la dmar mdangs rgyas pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ zhal las tsan dan ha ri'i rwi bro ba/ dar gos kyi na bza' bklubs/ rin chen sna tshogs kyis
mdzes pa'i rgyan spras shing / rig pa'i bstan bcos la mnga' brnyes pa/mdzangs ma'i yon tan brgyad dang ldan zhing / des khol mo mdzes ma gzhon nu ma bcu drug dang / skal rdzong du phan bde'i 'byung gnas jo bo shākya mu ne dang /gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i yig tshang chen mo/ gtsug lag gi yi ge sum brgya drug cu/ rgya yi gab rtsa/ gtsug lag sum brgya/ bzo yi rig byed pa drug cu/brtag thabs brgyad/ dpyad lnga sbyong drug sbyor sde bzhi sogs sman dpyad mtha' yas pa/ gser sga g.yu yi ka leb can/ legs nyes ston pa'i me long /rgyan gos stong phrag nyi shu/ gos dar za 'og seng ge bya brgyad la sogs dang /g.yos sna skal rdzong grangs las 'das pa bstsal/ bsu mi bod blon rta pa brgya dang / skyel ma zhu mi thang tha'e tsung gi spun mched cang shā wang dang li'i ta'o tsung sogs rta pa brgya/ kong jo drel dkar mo zhig la bcibs/ dar rgyal mang po rjes chibs sna khrid/ jo bo shākya mu ne shing rta 'khor lor gdan drangs/de bzhin skal rdzong gi dngos po rnams drel dang / rnga mong la bkal nas rta pa khyu dang khyu bcas te bod du phyags phebs so/ de nas bzung rgya bod mi rigs dbar sha rus kyi 'brel ba tshugs/ kong jo bod du phebs rjes thang rgyal rabs kyi sngon thon gyi rig gnas bod la khyab spel mdzad/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rgya'i sngon thon gyi rig gnas la sbyangs pa byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'byor pa legs pa'i phru gu du ma thang gi rgyal sa khrang an du slob gnyer byed par mngags/ srong btsan sgam po nyid dang nang blon gtso bo rnams kyis kyang rgya'i rig gnas la sbyangs pa legs par mdzad/ thang rgyal rabs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don sogs kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung ste bod kyi lam lugs khag la bsgyur bcos shulhas che
nga/dzad/bod sa sprel ( spyi lo 648)lor/ thang gi pho nya wang shon tshal sogs rgya gar du 'tshams 'dri byed par skyod skabs rgya gar bas thang gi pho nya mang po bkum stabs wang shon tshal gyis bod la dmag rogs bcol/ srong btsan sgam pos rta dmag khri tsho tsam btang ste rgya gar ba'i zing cha nying 'jags su btang /bod sa bya ( spyi lo 649)lor/ thang tha'e tsung gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ thang ku'o tsung mi 'jigs seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol/ khong khrir 'khod ma thag tu srong btsan sgam por h+phu rma zhes pa'i mag pa'i cho lo dang / de nas shi'i had cun wang zhes pa mtsho sngon rgyal po'i cho lo gnang bar brten chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos rgya dpon chan sun brgyud gong mar yi ge dang /gser gyi yo chas grangs bco lnga tsam phul thog gal srid gong ma nyid kyi chab 'bangs dang mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khag gis zing cha bslangs tshe dmag drangs nas rogs ram mtha' gcig tu byed rgyu'i khas blangs/ thang pa'o tsung shin tu dgyes te slar yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por ping wang ste nor 'dzin rgyal po'i cho lo gnang / pho nya rnams la rgya lugs kyi gsol ston zab rgyas bshams/bod kyi btsan po'i re 'dun ltar dar 'bu dang / shel/ chang / chu 'khor sogs bzo mi lag rtsal pa du ma bod du btang / de nas bzung rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba sgo kun nas gong du 'phel/ de nas khri lde gtsug brtan nam mes ag tshom gyi sku dus su slar yang thang rgyal rabs dang gnyen sgrig gi 'brel ba 'dzugs ched blon po sbas skyes bzang stong btsan dang /mchima~X rgyal gzig bu ting sogs pho nya rta pa sum cu lhag tsam mngags/ rin
po che sna tshogs dang sgrom bu khyer nas kong jo spyan 'dren par bskyod/ gnyen sgrig gi pho nya rnams rgyal sa khrung an du 'byor rjes thang krung tsung gis sne len zab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/ nyin zhig li yon thing tse zhes pa'i gnas der rta rtsed spo lo'i gzigs mor gdan drangs/ bod kyi pho nya rnams nas nga tsho'i gras la'ang rta rtsed spo lo shes pa yod pas gzigs mo zhig phul na 'grigs sam zhus/thang krung tsung gis de ltar 'grig zer/ gong ma'i rta rtsed spo lo ba dang / bod kyi rta rtsed spo lo ba gnyis 'gran bsdur byed bcug pas gong ma'i rta rtsed spo lo ba pham/ skabs der ltad mo ba'i gras su rta rtsed spo lor mkhas pa li'i lung cis('di ni rjes su gong ma thang shon tsung zhes pa 'di yin) yod stabs thang krung tsung gis khyed kyis mi 'ga' zhig btsal te bod kyi rta rtsed spo lo ba dang slar yang 'gran bsdur gyis shig ces bka' phab pa ltar li'i lung cis li g.yi dang / lngang hran ca'o/ 'u bu bcas bskongs nas 'gran bsdur byas pas bod kyi pho nya rnams pham/ mthar rgya bod mdza' brtse'i rta rtsed spo lo'i gzigs mo de mjug bsgril/bod lcags khyi(spyi lo710)lor/ thang klung tsung gis rang gi gsos phrug gzhon nu ma gyim shing kong jo bod la sbyin/ gong mas zhi drag dpon rigs brgya lhag tsam khrid nas hre phen shan zhes pa'i sa gnas bar kong jo skyel bar phebs/ yul der bod kyi gser yig pa rnams la gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel mtshon byed du ston mo rgya che gzab rgyas shig bshams/ gong mas kong jor bslab bya yang yang mdzad/ yul de'i btson pa thams cad thar du bcuglo gcig ring dpya khrul rnams med par mdzad/ kong jo gangs can gyi yul du phebs pa'i dran gso mtshon byed yul der gyim shing shan zhes ming bsgyuX/ de
nas blon po che ba gnyis dmag dang bcas pa'i skyel mar btang ste bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ gyim shing kong jo bya ba ni shes rig la mchog tu mnga' ba/sku byad legs la mthong ba tsam gyis yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yod/ skal rdzong du rin chen sna tshogs dang / rig gnas kyi bstan bcos du ma/ gos dar khri tsho mang po/ bzo rigs sna tshogs pa/ rol mo ba du ma mngags/ bod du so ma ra dza 'debs las byed pa'i lag rgyun yang de'i dus su dar/ gyim shing kong jo yab rje khri lde gtsug brtan gyi btsun mor mnga' gsol/ zla shas song rjes lha sras khri srong lde btsan brag dmar du sku 'khrungs/ btsan po'i btsun mo bgres pa sna nam bza' sngar bas zhe sdang skyes nas kong jo la blo nye ba'i tshul byas te lha sras tshur phyogs/ nga rang la skyes pa yin no zhes bsnyon byas/btsun mo rgan pa sku dbang che bas gyim shing kong jo bya dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/ de nas lha sras zhabs 'dzugs kyi dga' ston nyin btsan po gser khri'i steng na bzhugs/ g.yas gral du sna nam pa rnams bzhugs/ lha sras dgyes par byed pa'i yo byad dang / rgyan gos/ me tog gi phreng ba sna tshogs 'khyer 'ongs/ g.yon gral na rgya yi gnyen 'khor rnams bzhugs/ sras la rgyan du mas brgyan te bzhugs gral dbus na gdan drangs/ yab rje na re/ma gnyis la skyes pa'i bu gcig pu/ /snod gser skyogs chang gis gang ba 'di/ /bu khyod kyi zhang po'i lag tu sprod/ /ma gang yin yid ches de la byed/ /ces gsungs/ dmod bor nas sras gom pa thub tsam de btang bas skadas spyar sna nam pa rnams kyis rgyan gos dang / me tog gi phreng ba sogs
bstan te tshur 'ong ba'i brda ji ltar btang yang / rgya rnams kyi rtsar phyin/gser skyogs rgya la gtad nas/nga khri srong lde btsan rgya tsha yin/ /sna nam gang gi don mi 'tshal/ /zhes smras/ zhang po rgya yi pang du song ngo / der yum kong jo shin tu dgyes nas 'di skad gsungs so/ /tshe sngon ma'i las kyis 'phen pa yis/ /nga rgya nas 'ong ba'i bu mo la/ /rje 'gran med rgyal po'i sras gcig 'khrungs/ /las gang yang srid pa'i sngon chad la/ /bu rang la skyes pa gzhan gyis phyogs/ /gtam bden pa'i tshig la ma nyan zhing / /brang nu ma bstan kyang ma gtad pas/ /nga rgya mo'i sems la gzhob tu thal/ /sems khong khro'i na tsha ma bzod par/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams su bcug /dus de ring lha yi nyi ma shar/ /bu khyod kyis zhang po ngo shes lags/ /nga a ma'i lus sems mal du bde/ /yul bod kyi ri dpyad nyams pa de/ /ri de rnams skyon med bcos su yod/ /der gyim shing kong jo'i lha sras yin pa ngo shes nas dga' ston gyi spyan mo
gzab rgyas byas so/ /gyim shing kong jo khri gtsug lde btsan gyi khab tu bzhes pa 'di ni rgya bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog tu slar yang gal 'gangs che ba'i bya ba zhig red/des sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas thang bod dbar gyi mdza' brtse'i mthun lam la shugs snon thebs thub pa ma zad/ thang gi sngon thon gyi shes rig lag rtsal bod la khyab spel btang bar brten bod kyi rig gnas lag rtsal sgo kun nas gong 'phel 'gro bar skul ma shugs chen thebs/ thang bod dbar dmag mtshams chod/ phan tshun tshong ra btsugs/ tshong las kyang gong 'phel ches cher phyin/de nas btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan ral pa can gyi sku dus su rgya bod mthun lam yun gnas yong ched rgya yul rme ru bya ba'i sa mtshams su btsan po dbon zhang gnyis kyi lha khang re re brtsigs/ rdo pha bong la nyi zla'i gzugs bkod nas/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes zer/skabs der rdo la nyi zla'i gzugs bkod nas rgya bod dbon zhang gi mdza' mthun mtshon tshul byed pa de rigs ni da lta'ang 'phyongs rgyas kyi rdo ring che mor dngos su mjal rgyu 'dug de rjes bod lcags glang ( spyi lo 821 )lor/ bod kyi pho nya rnams thang gi rgyal sa khrang an du 'byor/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan dang / blon chen bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyi bka' bzhin khrang an gyi nub ngos su thang gi blon po rnams dang bka' gros legs par mdzad/ bod chu stag ( spyi lo 822)lor/ thang gi pho nya rnams lha sar 'byor/ khong rnams la bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas mdzad/ blon chen bran kha dpal gyi yon tan sogs spyapon rigs brgya lhag tsam dang / thang gi pho nya rnams lha sa'i shar
ngos su gros mol gnang / phyogs gnyis gas mdza' mthun gyi lo rgyus la dran gso yang yang mdzad/ lhag par du rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi pad+ma dang / gyim shing kong jo bod kyi btsan pos khab tu bzhes tshul/ rgya bod dbon zhang gi 'brel ba sogs lhug por gleng / bka' gros mdzad skabs mdza' brtse'i rnam pas khengs/ mna' mthun gyi rdo ring gsum btsugs pa ste/ gcig ni thang gi rgyal sa khrung an gyi nub ngos dang / gcig ni thang bod sa mtshams rme ru dang /gcig ni lha sa gtsug lag khang gi mdun ngos jo bo dbu sku'i 'gram bcas la btsugs/ khrang an du btsugs pa'i rdo ring de'i thog rgya yig bkod yod pha dang / da lta'ang shis an gyi nub ngos su bsdad yod skad/ lha sar btsugs pa'i rdo ring de da lta'ang dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ mdor na thang rgyal rabs kyi dus su rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse dang sha rus kyi 'brel ba btsugs pa tsam ma zad/ nyin bzhin dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar gong du 'phel/dbon zhang mdza' brtse'i dpal la ci dgar rol bzhin gnas so/ /de nas dus rabs dgu pa'i nang bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sngar las rno ngar can du gyur pa dang / lhag par du dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul du chos lugs kha la khyer nas srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod de nyin bzhin rno ngar dang / dze drag rnyog 'dzing can du gyur bar brten mthar bod me stag ( spyi lo 846)lor lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes glang dar ma bkrongs/ yul khams 'khrugs/ glang dar ma'i sras 'od srung dang / gdung rgyud rdzun mar grags pa sras yum brtan gnyis nar ma son skabs phyogs so sor blon po 'ga' zhig dang / btsun mo rgan gzhon gnyis kyis rgyab langs byas te srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod yang yang langs/ phyogs patshungs
bod sa glang (spyi lo869)lor/ thog mar mdo khams yul nas 'bangs gyen log langs/ de rjes dbus gtsang yul gru du mar gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis 'bangs gyen log langs te btsan po'i bang so mang che ba bshig dpon rigs mang po bkrongs bar brten btsan po'i gdung rgyud dang blon po rnams dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te mnga' ris sogs yul gru gang sar bros thog yul sde mang por khyim dud stong tsam dang / yang khyim dud brgya'am bcu phrag 'ga' zhig las med pa'i srid dbang mang po btsugs/ gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus par bod sil bur gyur/de bzhin bod me yos ( spyi lo907)lor/ thang rgyal rabs 'thor zhig tu phyin/ rgyal nang du'ang rgyal rabs lnga dang / rgyal khab bcu zhes pa'i kha 'thor gyi gnas su gyar/ de rjes rgyal rabs lnga dang / rgyal khrab bcu phan tshun dbar srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i dmag 'khrug yang yang langs pa dang / rgyal yongs sa gnas khrag gi zhing pa'i 'os langs dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur/ skabs der rgyal nang dang bod du kha 'thor gyi gnas tshul ji ltar byung na'ang thang gong ma dang chos rgyal mes dbon rnams kyis gsar du gtod pa'i rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse'i mthun lam dang sha rus kyi 'brel ba de chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin gnas/ lhag par du sung khra'o rgyal rabs dbu brnyes pa'i rjes su rgya bod mi rigs dbar chab srid dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi thad 'brel ba gang legs byung ba dang /rgya bod mi rigs gnyis kyis sa gnas mang por tshong ra btsugs te tshong las kyi bya gzhag nyin bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel/mi nas rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags byi ( spyi lo1240)lor/ yangs pa'i
sa gzhi kun la dbang sgyur pa hor jing ger rgyal po'i gdung brgyud e chen go dan rgyal pos hor gyi dmag dpon chen po do ra rta nag pos gtsos pa'i hor dmag khri 'ga' zhig bod du btang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta mes rgya'/ nang khul du gdan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' phab/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug ( spyi lo1244)lor/ pho nya mngags te gdan zhu'i chab shog gnang / rgya sman gyis sa skyar bskyod de chab shog gi lung bsgrags/ hor gyi 'ja' sa gdan 'dren ma las 'di ltar 'byung ste 88tshe ring gnam gyi shed mong la bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung / sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la go bar byed pa'i gtam/ nged pha ma dang gnam sa'i drin lan 'jal ba'i phyir/ lam gyi blang dor ma nor ba ston shes pa'i bla ma gcig dgos pa brtag pa byed pa'i dus khyod 'dug pas/ lam gyi dka' tshegs la mi blta bar yong dgos/ gal te na so rgas zer na sngon thub pa'i dbang pos sems can gyi don du lus grangs med sbyin par gtong ba ji tsam/khyod kyis chos go ba'i dam bca' dang e 'gal/ ngas mtha'i khrims ra blangs dmag dpung chen pos brda ded byas nas sems can mang po la gnod pa byas na mi skrag pa e yin/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can mang po soms la khyod mgyogs par shog nyi ma nub phyogs kyi ban+de rnams khyod shes su 'jug pa yin/ gnang sbyin la dngul bre chen lnga/ gos chen gyi chos gos mu tig gi tshom bu can la mu tig stong phrag drug dang nyis brgya/ gos lu hang gi ring 'gag lham 'bob dang bcas pa/ kha ti kha tshang ma yug gnyis/ thon ti kha tshang ma yug gnyis/ gos chen sna lnga yug nyi shu rnams yod/ 'di'i lon la rdor sri mgon dang dbon jo dar ma gnyis btang ba yin/ 'brug1 ༈ zla ba
brgyad pa'i gnam gang la bris zhes 'khod/rab byung bzhi pa'i shing 'brug (spyi lo 1244)lor/ hor e chen go dan rgyal pos gdan 'dren zhus ma thag tu sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bod ser skya mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun legs par sgrub ched sa skya nas chibs kha bsgyur te rim gyis mes rgyal nang khul du phebs/ me rta (spyi lo1246)lo'i zla ba brgyad par leng kra'u zhes pa'i sa gnas der 'byor/skabs der e chen go dan rgyal po hor yul du bzhud nas mi bzhugs kyang rgyal po'i sku mched dang / blon 'bangs rnams nas sne len dang bsu ba rgya che gzab rgyas mdzad/ me lug (spyi lo1247)lo'i zla ba dang por e chen go dan rgyal po leng kra'u la phyir log mdzad/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bod seraskya mi dmangs yongs kyi tshab mdzad de e chen go dan rgyal por 'tshams 'dri dang 'bul ba legs par gsol/ go dan rgyal po'ang thugs shin tu mnyes nas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bka' mol mang po gnang / de nas e chenago dan rgyal po dang sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gnyis bod 'di nyid dngos su mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su bsgyur ba'i skor la bka' gros zhib par mdzad/ mthar sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bod kyi lha sde mi sde yongs la bslab bya'i bka' yig gnang / de nas bzung bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bsnyon med du gyur/ e chen go dan rgyal pos sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi bdag por bskos/ go dan rgyal po'i stobs shugs la brten nas lo ngo bzhi brgya lhag tsam kha 'thor rgu 'thor du song ba'i bod sil bu de gcig tu bsgyur thog bod yongs kyi chab srid kyi bdag po mdzad/༵ba byung bzhi pa'i lcags phag ( spyi lo 1251 ) lor/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta
'das/ de rjes phag mo gru pa dang / 'bri gung pa/ tshal pa/ stag lung pa/g.ya' bzang pa sogs yul dpon rnams nas rang nyid kyi srid dbang dang /mnga' 'bangs/ sa zhing / 'brog thang / sems can sogs kyi bdag dbang yun gnas sra brtan yong ched bang mi mngags te hor rgyal por 'tshams 'dri dang 'bul ba phul/ de nas se chen rgyal po khri la 'khod ma thag tu 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gdan drangs nas mjal 'phrad gnang / rab byung bzhi pa'i chu byi ( spyi lo1252)lor/ hor dmag gis tā li rgyal khab tu dpung 'jug byed skabs hor se chen rgyal pos dmag mi 'bum gnyis khrid nas bod la dmag lam byas pa ma zad/ mdo khams khul du dmag btang ste dbus gtsang dang / mnga' ris bcas kyi yul sde srid dbang slar yang dbang du 'dus/ rab byung bzhi pa'i chu glang ( spyi lo 1253)lo'i gnam lo gsar tshes nyin 'gro mgon 'phags pa dgung lo bcu dgu la phebs pa'i skabs su se chen rgyal pos dbang zhus/ ti shri ste gong ma'i slob dpon gyi mtshan gsol/ de nas rim bzhin kwa don gu shri ste rgyal po'i slob dpon gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ g.yang kri'u las grub pa'i ri mo la yi ge dang rin po che yod pa'i tham kha phul/ de'i phyi lo shing stag ( spyi lo1254)lor/se chen rgyal pos 'ja' sa bod yig ma dang / ban+de shed bskyed ma zhes pa dang /dngul bre chen lnga bcu rtsa drug ja sigs nyis brgya/ gos yug brgyad bcu/dar yug stong dang brgya phul/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ bsde'i khang par gser yig pas 'tsher mi 'bab pa dang / 'u lag mi bskul ba/ khral mi 'ded pa byed dgos pa hor se chen rgyal pos zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad/ 13
rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags sprel ( spyi lo1260)lor/ hor se chen rgyal po khad phen ( nang sog gi sa gnas shig) la han gyi khrir 'khod/ rgyal po der rang rgyal byang phyogs sa khul gyi sa bdag rnams kyi rgyab skyor rogs ram thob ste byang phyogs khul gyi dbang bsgyur gi go gnas sra brtan byung ba dang 'brel lo shas ring dmag grabs gang legs byas te mu mthud nas sung lho mar dpung 'jug byas/ skabs der rgyal yongs kyi sa cha mang che ba hor gyis dbang du 'dus/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi ( spyi lo 1264)lor/ rgyal sa yan cing ( da lta'i pe cing grong khyer) du spos/ bod rab byung lnga pa'i lcags 'u ga ( spyi lo 1271 )lor/ rgyal rabs kyi ming bsgyur nas yon zhes btags/ rab byung bzhi pa'i shing byi ( spyi lo 1264 )lor/ se chen rgyal pos tsung kre yon zhes pa'i spyi khyab las khungs shig btsugs/ 'di ni rgyal yongs kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs las don gyi dbang 'dzin las khungs mtho shos shig yin la/ bod rigs kyi dmag dmangs dang / chos lugs las don gyi las khungs mtho shos shig kyang red/ gna' rabs thang gong mas shon kun pho brang nang bod kyi pho nyar mjal 'phrad gnang bas lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i pho brang de'i ming gzhir bzung / rab byung lnga pa'i sa byi ( spyi lo 1288)lor/ tsung kre yon zhes pa'i spyi khyab las khungs de shon kun yon zhes bsgyur/ 'di ni yon gong ma se chen gyis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs su dngos su bsgyur rjes bod kyi phyi nang gi las don gal che mtha' dag la bkod 'doms dang 'go khrid byed pa'i srid 'dzin gyi las khungs mtho shos shig red/ skabs der 'gro mgon 'phags pas srid 'dzin las khungs de'i las 'dzin mdzad/ de rjes yon se chen go~X mas rim bzhin bod rigs sa khul du shon dbu hre si tu'u yon hrad
h+phu zhes pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs gsum btsugs/ de dag gis nub byang sa khul dang / lho nub sa khul/ dbus gtsang / mnga' ris sa khul bcas kyi bod rigs dmag dmangs rnams kyi 'go 'dzin mdzad/ srid 'dzin las khungs de dag gi dpon rigs khrag yon se chen gong mas bsko gzhag stsal ba dang / bod kyi yul dpon che gras khrag la khri dpon dang / stong dpon sogs bsko gzhag stsal/ bod khri skor bcu gsum de dag sa skya pas spyi khyab dbang 'dzin byed pa'i bka' phab/de nas rab byung lnga pa'i me yos ( spyi lo 1267)lor/ se chen gong ma'i bkod mngags bzhin 'gro mgon 'phags pas hor yig gsar gtod mdzad grub rjes pe cing du phebs/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa 'khor dang bcas pa pe cing du 'byor rjes se chen gong mas pho brang che mor mjal 'phrad gnang /hor yig gi yig phud phul bas gong ma thugs lhag par dgyes bzhin 88gnam gyi 'og sa'i steng rgya gar gyi lha'i sras po/ yi ge rtsom mi sprul pa'i sangs rgyas/rgyal khams 'jags su 'jug mi/ snyan ngag ge rgyu/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa ti shri ltazhes pa'i mtshan gsol/'gro mgon 'phags pa dgongs pa rdzogs rjes 'gro mgon phyag na rdo rje bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi bdag por bskos/ 'dir yon gong ma chen pos sa len wang gi lung dang / gser tham gnang / bod la ti shri ste gong ma'i slob dpon dang / wang zhes pa rgyal po'i las 'dzin 'phags pa dang / phyag na bcas sku mched 'di gnyis kyi sku dus su byung bar grags pas bod la bka' drin lhag par che/skabs der yon gong ma chen pos bod khri skor bcu gsum du dud 5glangs
gtsang bsher dang / khral 'ul lam lugs/ dpon rigs che gras khrag bsko 'then byed phyogs sogs gal che'i gtan 'bebs rab dang rim pa mdzad/de nas sa skya'i gdung brgyud nang khul phan tshun mi mthun stabs sa skya pa'i stobs shugs nyin bzhin nyams rgud du 'gro ba dang 'brel phag gru'i stobs shugs ches cher phyin/ phag gru dang / 'bri g.ya' tshal gsum sogs dbar dmag 'khrug langs te de dag rim bzhin phag gru'i mnga' 'og tu 'dus/ de bzhin phag gru dang / sa skya ba'i dbar la'ang 'gal ba ches cher phyin te dmag 'khrug langs/ rab byung drug pa'i shing rta ( spyi lo1354 )lor/phag gru'i dmag dpung sa skyar 'byor/ zhi drag gi 'thab rtsod sna tshogs la brten nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po btson nas bton/ dmag dpung gis sa skya'i dgon pa mtha' bskor thog sa skya'i dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus pham ste gson por bzung / de nas bzung sa skya'i srid dbang 'thor 'ig tu phyin/ rab byung drug pa'i shing rta ( spyi lo1354)lor/ khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis drung chen shes rab bkra shis la seng ge'i pags pa sder bzhi ma nyams pa sogs 'bul ba mang po bskur te gong ma'i drung du btang /yon gong ma tho bkan the'i mur la yin min gnas lugs gsal zhing gsal bar zhus/ gong ma chen pos bod kyi da yod kyi gnas tshul dngos la dbye zhib dang / dus bde zhi 'jags myur du yong ched khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan la tā si tu ste gong ma'i las rogs kyi go gnas dang / bod yongs kyi srid dbang rtsis blangs chog pa'i bka' shog dang tham kha bcas gnang / de nas bzung phag gru'i srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa dang / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshon 'di nyid kyang bod sa gnas srid dbang gi byed po gtso bor gyur/
gong gsal dngos yod 'di dag gi thog nas skabs der bod la gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che ba dang / dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i khyod shi nga gson gyi 'thab rtsod rab dang rim pa byung yang phyogs gnyis rdzas yon khra'o krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang len byed dgos pa gsal por mthong thub/de nas gnam 'og 'gran zla med pa'i yon gong ma 'di nyid kyang snum zad sgron me lta bur gyur/ gong ma'i lha sras rnams phan tshun srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i srid 'gyur yang yang langs/ rab byung lnga pa'i me lug ( spyi lo1307)lo nas rab byung drug pa'i chu bya ( spyi lo1333)lo bar phi lo nyi shu rtsa drug ring yon gong ma thengs brgyad tsam brjes/ dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba ches rno ngar dang dza drag che ba'i gnas su gyur/ dus mtshungs zhing pa'i gsar brdze'i mtho rlabs gsar pa 'phyur nas li'u h+phu thung dang / ko'o tse shin gyis snga rjes su 'os langs byas/ mthar ko'o tse shin gyi dmag dpon kru'u yon krang gis ( spyi lo 1328 — 1398 )yon gong ma'i srid dbang mgo rting slograb byung drug pa'i sa sprel ( spyi lo 1368) lor/ nan cing rgyal sar byas te ming rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs/ de ma thag tu phag gru'i srid dbang gi bdag po 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan dang zhwa nag kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis rgyal sa nan cing du bang mi btang ste ming rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs par rten 'brel dang btsi bkur zhus/ ming gong ma chen po kru'u yon krangagis 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan la tā si tu ste gong ma'i las rogs dang / chin go lung / kwa shin gu shri zhes pa'i rgyal khab slob dpon pastag gi
nor bu zhes pa'i cho lo dang / dam kha gnang ba ma zad/ bod chol kha gsum dbang 'dzin chog pa'i 'ja' sa'ang stsal/ming rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs pa'i rjes su yon rgyal rabs dang 'dra bar bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs bsnyon med cig tu brtsis nas bdag dbang yongs su lag len bltar/ mes rgyal nang khul dang / lhag par du yun nan dang / kud kra'u/ zi khron/ kong shi sogs grangs nyung mi rigs kyi sa khul la btsugs pa'i dmag don dang srid 'dzin gyi lam lugs de dag bod du'ang lag len bltar/ rab byung drug pa'i chu byi ( spyi lo 1372)lor/bod du dbus gtsang 'ing tu'u kre hud hri si zhes pa bkod 'doms spyi khyab khang btsugs/ rim pa khag gi ser skya dpon rigs mtha' dag ming gong ma chen pos bsko ga'ag stsal/rab byung drug pa'i chu glang ( spyi lo 1373) lor/ tā si tu 'jam dbyangs shākya rgyal mtshan dgongs pa rdzogs/ de rjes mi yi dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan gser khrir mnga' gsol/ sa 'brug ( spyi lo1388)lor/ ming gong ma chen pos hung kus wang zhes pa rgyal po'i cho lo dang / kwa ting go shri ste rgyal khab slob dpon gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang / gser gyi dam kha gnang / de nas bzung mtshan du wang grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes yangs pa'i yul gru kun tu snyan par grags par gyur/ de rjes rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang ( spyi lo1409)lor/ ming gong ma yung los hran hwa wang zhes pa'i cho lo dang shel gyi dam kha gnang ba dang / rdzong chen so so'i rdzong dpon khrag la'ang mi brgyud dang bcas par 'ja' sa dang shel gyi dam kha gnang /sdub byung bdun pa'i sa byi ( spyi lo 1408)lor/ ming gong ma chen po
yung los 'ja' sa dang pho nya bzhi sogs gser yig pa mang du btang nas tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa mes rgyal nang khul du gdan drangs kyang skabs der lha ldan smon lam chen mo 'dzugs pa'i grabs mdzad dgos pa dang / sku khams bde min la brten mes rgyal nang khul du phebs mi thub stabs dgongs zhu mdzad/ rje nyid kyi dngos slob gtso bo byams chen chos rje sogs pe cing du gtong gnang mdzad pas gong ma chen po thugs shin tu dgyes/ ming gong ma drang dzu'u yis byams chen chos rjer twā tshe h+pha wang ste snying rdze chen po chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa'i cho lo stsal/ ming shon tsung gis gu shri'i cho lo dang / gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa gnang /de nas rim bzhin phag gru'i dbang 'dzin pa nang khul mi mthun par 'gal ba ches cher phyin pa dang / phyag gru dang / sa skya/ tshal pa/ 'bri gung /g.ya' bzang sogs dbar slar yang srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i dmag 'khrug yang yang langs/ de dzes kurma bstan skyong dbang pos phag gru'i srid dbang dngos su mgo rting slog ste kurma pa'i srid dbang dngos su btsugs/kurma pa sku phreng bcu pa chos rgyal chos dbyings rdo rje bod yongs kyi chos rgyal gyi khrir bskos/ rang gis rang la gtsang pa rgyal po zhes pa'i ming btags/ bod kyi sa cha mang che ba kha lo bsgyur/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me glang ( spyi lo 1637) lor/ gu shri han dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dbus su 'byor/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas mdzad/ de rjes gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dbus kyi sa gnas gtso bo khag la bskor zhib mdzad de mtsho sngon du phyir byon khul gyis glo bur du gtsang pa sde srid garma bstan skyong dbang por phar ༷༵ bas
phan tshun dmag 'thab drag po thengs mang brgyab/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse sog dmag gis mtha' bskor/ gtsang pa sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang po dpon 'khor 'ga' zhig yul gzhan du bros/ gtsang dmag rnams dbang med du mgo btags/ mthar sog dmag gis gtsang pa sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang po bkrongs/ rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas gzhis rtser gdan drangs/ bod yongs kyi srid kyi bdag por gyur/dus der zhing pa'i 'os la ngas gcig mjug gnyis mthud du langs te ming rgyal rabs kyi srid dbang mgo rting slog nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sprel ( spyi lo1644)lor chin rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs/ de 'phral rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis nas 'thus mi mngags te/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung dngos su btsugs par rten 'brel dang brtsi bkur zhus/krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod la gang ci'i rgyab skyor rogs ram yong ba'i 'dun pa gsol/ gong ma shun tsi thugs lhag par dgyes nas se chen chos rje lha sar phyir phebs skabs tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / paṇa chen/ sa skya chos rgyal/ stag lung chos rgyal/ kurma pa sogs la 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge dang /gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa gnang / gong ma chen pos bod kyi skye 'gro bde zhing skyid pa dang / chos dang srid kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa yong ba'i ched du rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang ba'i zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad/de nas chen krung dbyang srid gzhung gis pho nya mngags te rgyal mchog lnga pa chen2 ༈ dang / paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa rnam gnyis mes rgyal nang khul du
phebs dgos pa'i bka' phab/ skabs der paṇa chen rin po che sku na smin pas phebs ma thub/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu 'brug ( spyi lo1652)lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga ( rgya bod yig tshang 'ga' zhig tu zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bdun nam tshes nyer bdun nyin zhes 'khod) nyin chin gong ma chen po'i bka' bkod ltar rgyal mchog lnga pa sku 'khor dang bcas pa mes rgyal nang khul du phebs/ rgyal sa pe cing du phebs skabs gong ma chen pos sne len dang bsu ba gzab rgyas mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser gyi byang bu gser chos kyi shog bu mthug shos dang mnyam pa bco lnga 'phrul mig tu sbrel te ltebs chog pa zhig thog nub kyi lha gnas ches dge bar bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung / gnam 'og skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa/ 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes rgya bod hor gsum gyi yi ge shan sbyar 'khod pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / de nas rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po sa chu 'phrod min la brten bod la phyir log chog pa'i dgongs zhu mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos dgongs 'khrol gnang ba ltar rgyal mchog lnga pa pe cinganas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ ta'i khar zhes pa'i sa gnas der 'byor mtshams gong ma chen pos slar yang pho nya gnyis mngags te gser yig dang /thamag kha ris su yig rigs bzhi sbyar ba 'bru don du/ nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas bstan pa mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo je 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes pa stsal/ gong ma chem pos gser gyi 'ja' sa dang / gser tham gnang ba ma zad/ chab srid thog rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu gnang bar brten rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i mtshan snyanaphyogs yongs su grags/ dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang sngadī pyaX sra
brtan du gyur/de nas ring por mi thogs par bod sog dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba je cher gyur/ stabs mi legs pa zhig la/ 'thab rtsod 'gag rtsa'i skabs te rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ( spyi lo1682)lo'i zla ba 3tshes15nyin rgyal ba lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dgung grangs drug bcu re drug la phebs te gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ phyi nang gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che bas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog gis rgyal dbang lnga pa'i 'al chems ltar dgos dbang gis gsang rgya mdzad/ sngar ba'in chin krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur dang / mtha' bzhi'i mi rigs gzhan dang mthun lam/ bod kyi lugs gnyis bya ba legs par bskyangs/ de nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma khang shi'i mchog gis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshor wang zhes pa rgyal po'i cho lo dang / rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhes 'khod pa'i tham ga stsal/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma khang shi'i mchog nas rgyal mchog lnga pa sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul mkhyen rjes sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 'thus mi mngags te skabs der bod kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che bas rgyal mchog lnga pa'i zhal chems ltar gsang rgya mdzad dgos lugs dang / yang srid tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa'i skor sogs zhib phra'i gnas lugs gser snyan sgron pas/ gong ma mchog nas de ltar mos mthun gnang ba tsam las mi 'grigs pa'i bka' rtsad gang yang ma phebs/bod sog dbang 'dzin pa'i dbar gyi 'gal ba je cher gyur nas lha bzang han gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bkrongs/ de rjes sog po jun gar ba'i da~Xg dpung lha sar lhags te lha bzang han dmar gsod btang / bod
la zing cha chen po langs te bod rigs mi dmangs rnams sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i skabs der gong ma khang shi'i mchog gis dmag dpung btang /gong ma khang shi'i sras bzhi pa yun thi rgyang bskyod dmag dpung dpung sde chen po drug gi spyi khyab dmag spyi chen por bsko gzhag stsal/ mdo khams sogs dmag lam 'ga' zhig bgos te sdig can jun gar ba'i dpung tshogs bcom par chas pas jun gar ba'i dpung dmag dngangs skrag rab tu skyes te 'tshab 'tshub ngang gtsang phyogs su bros/ bskor gsum gyi dmag dpung dang /gtsang dmag kong dmag sogs kyis gong ma'i dmag dpung la ram 'degs byas te lcags byi ( spyi lo 1720 )lor jun gar ba'i dpung dmag yongs rdzogs bod nas mthar bskrad/ yul lung bde zhing skyid par gyur/ bod 'bangs skyes bu yongs nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i dpung dmag bod du lhags par dga' bsu dang brtsi bkur tshad med zhus/ 'di ni mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams sra brtan gtong bar lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba bzang po zhig yin pas kun gyis yang yang bsngags/de nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bka' ba'in rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi ( spyi lo 1720) lo'i zla ba4tshes22nyin tā la'i sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho sku 'bum nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ gong ma chen pos gser yig dang / gnang sbyin rin chen dang dar gos sna tshogs stsal/lcags byi ( spyi lo 1720)lo'i zla ba9tshes 15nyin rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ 'di lo nas gong ma'i cang cun dang / gung tshe dbang nor bu/ don grub wang / bstan 'dzin ( blo bzang bstan 'dzin )wang / e sis pi'i li/ pas si nga phod rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa )sna shis
rgyal po sogs rgya bod tshogs 'du chen mos lo gcig ring srid kyi kha lo bsgyur/skabs de'i lung bsgyur pa bstan 'dzin chin wang zhes pa'i dam phrug 'bru don du(4blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi tham ga7zhes pa de spyad/rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags glang (spyi lo 1721) lor/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos khang chen nas bsod nams rgyal po dang / nga phrod rdo rje rgyal por bka' yi blon por bsko gzhag stsal/ de rjes pas si'i cho lo gnang / lum pa ba bkra shis rgyal por gung gi cho lo dang bka' yi blon por bsko gzhag gnang / de bzhin pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po yang bka' yi blon por bskos/ 66pas si khang chen nas gtso bo/ pas si nga phod pas rogs ram sogs phying sang rnams kyi tham ga rgyal dge'o5zhes 'bru don 'khod pa'i gser tham stsal/ khang chen par66da'i ching ba dur gyi tham ga zhes pa'i sger tham zhig stsal/ de rjes khang chen nas dang / nga lum sbyar gsum dbar 'gal ba je cher phyin nas mthar nga lum sbyar gsum gyis khang chen nas bsod nams rgyal po bkrongs/ pho lha bas gtsang khul du dmag skul brgyab ste dbus gtsang dmag 'khrug langs/ dus der bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gsal por rtogs te snga rjes su nang blon khang gi zho hre seng ge dang / h+phu tu'u thung mā la/ tru cang yan chin sogs pho nyar mngags te bod kyi gnas tshul la rtogs zhib mdzad/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa sprel (spyi lo1728)lor/ dmag dpon chen po khra lang ang dang / rmad lu'u sogs kyis sne 'khrid pa'i dpon dmag brgyad stong bzhi brgya lhag tsam zi ling brgyud bod du 'ongasakhu/4 sdon chen kra'u dbyings kyis sne drangs pa'i zi khron gyi dpung dmag
bzhi stong lhag tsam dkar mdzes brgyud de bod du 'ongs/ de bzhin dmag dpon nan than zhang gis gtso 'khrid gnang ba'i dpung dmag sum stong tsam yun nan nas bod du lhags/ dmag lam gsum gyi rta dmag dang rkang dmag chig khri lnga stong bzhi brgya tsam lha sar 'byor ba'i rjes dmag dpon chen po khra lang ang gis bod bzhugs gong ma'i pho nya mā la sogs khong rnams dang bka' gros legs par mdzad/ nga lum sbyar gsum gyis byas nyes la gzhigs te khrims kyis tshar bcad/ rgyal yab bsod nams dar rgyas ni thengs 'di'i dus zing dang 'brel ba che rkyen gong ma yung kran gyi bka' ltar sa sprel (spyi lo1728)zla12tshes13nyin skal bzang rgya mtsho dang / rgyal yab bsod nams dar rgyas sogs dkar mdzes khul gyi mgar thar gdan drangs nas lo bdun bzhugs/pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal la pas si'i cho lo dang jun wang zhes pa'i 'ja' sa/ gser tham che mo 'bru don du88dbus gtsang gi bka' slob kyi bya ba byed mkhan rdo ros pas si'i tham ga zhes yi ge gsum sbyar ma zhig stsal/ bod kyi chab srid kyi byed por bskos/ de bzhin bod kyi srid 'dzin la shugs snon byed ched bod sdod am ban btsugs pa'i lam lugs gsar du gtod/ sa sprel(spyi lo1728)lor/ bod bzhugs am ban dang po mā la dang / de'i las rogs seng ge/ dmag mi nyis stong tsam bod du 'byor/ chab mdor yun nan gyi dmag mi tshig stong tsam bzhag pa sogs byed thabs du ma lag len bstar bas mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur yong ba dang / bod mi dmangs kyi bde 'jags la'ang phan thogs ches cher byung /rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing yos (spyi lo1735)lo'i za3tshepa(1nyin/
gong ma yung kun gyi bkod mngags ltar/ h+phu tu'u h+phu hra'u sogs dpon dmag lnga brgyas tā la'i bla ma skal bzang rgya mtsho bod du gdan drangs/ skabs der bod kyi chab srid kyi bdag po mi dbang pho lha ba dang / am ban rnam gnyis nas mdzad/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa lug ( spyi lo1739)lor gong ma chan lung gis pho lha bar tho lo jun wang gi cho lo dang de'i sras rgan pa 'gyur med tshe brtan la mnga' ris gung gi cho lo gnang bas stod mnga' ris bskor gsum gyi dmag srid kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/ gzhon pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal la tha'i ji rim pa dang po'i cho lo gnang stabs 'dam brgya shog brgyad dang tsho pa so dgu'i 'go 'dzin mdzad/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i me yos ( spyi lo1747)lo'i zla1par mi dbang pho lha ba dga' lhan khang gsar du dgongs pa rdzogs/ zla1par sras gzhon pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal la jun wang zhes pa'i cho lo dang / pha dus ltar bod kyi las don gyi byed po gtso bor bsko gzhag stsal/ gser tham chen mo skad yig gsum sbyar gyi zhal ris su 88dbus gtsang gi bka' slob bya ba byed mkhan tho jun wang gi tham ga zhes 'bru don 'khod pa zhig stsal/ yab pho lha bar stsal ba'i dmar tham khrag gnyis kyang rang 'jags gnang / 'on kyang sras 'gyur med rnam rgyal khrir 'khod ma thag tu yab pho lha ba'i lam phyogs dang yongs su rgyab 'gal gyis gong ma chan lung la brtsi bkur mi zhu ba dang / bod bzhugs am ban la ngo rgol/ lkog tu sog po jun gar bar ngan 'brel/ gcen po 'gyur med tshe brtan bkrongs pa sogs spyod ngan rab dang rim pa spel bar brten lcags rta ( spyi lo1750 )lo'i zla10tshes13nyin bod bzhugs am ban h+phu chin dakhushā / ༷ las rogs lab tun gnyis kyis 'gyur med rnam rgyal tshar bcad/
de'i rjes 'brang pas zing cha bslangs te bod bzhugs am ban rnam gnyis bkrongs/de nas song ma chan lung mchog gi bka' bzhin rdo ring no yon pa paṇ+ḍi ta bod kyi rgya'/ tshab tu bsko gzhag stsal/skabs der bka' shag las khungs dngos su btsugs/ gtso bo rdo ring no yon pa paṇ+ḍi ta mgon po don grub rab brtan dang / las rogs dza sag mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring darnga1ro rgyal/ dza sag thon pa sri gcod tshe brtan/ser mo ba rtse mgron dar han nyi ma rgyal mtshan bcas bzhi bka' blon du bskos/de bzhin rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya ṭ+ṭa nor 88tsi tsi yo'unya ste 86spyan ras gzigs zhes 'bru don du 'khod pa'i bang( gi de dag rang 'jags su stsal/bka' shag tu dam phrug bde skyid nyi ma dang / sel dam rtags dam bcas gnang / drung mgron 'gag ces bka' drung dang / bka' mgron/ 'gag pa bcas 'dzugs pa'i srol gtod/ de rjes yig tshang las khungs dngos su btsugs/de rjes lcags glang ( spyi lo1781 )lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po chan lung gi bka' bzhin twā la'i brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho srid khrir dbang bskur/ 'ja' sa dang gser tham che mo 'bru don du (6nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po ltazhes 'khod pa zhig stsal/ rta tshag rje drung sbi li thu ste kun gling rgyal thog dang po ye shes bstan pa'i mgon pos rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las kyi ram 'degs gzengs thon pa mdzad stabs chu byi ( spyi lo1792 )lor / gong ma chan lung mchog gis sa ma ti pak+ṣa 'am phu thung ga'an zi'i cho 'o gnang2 shā dang /
'bru don du88ye shes yongs rdzogs bsam gtan mkhan po zhes 'khod pa'i dngul dam che mo sku sger du rgyun 'jags gsol ras stsal/dus der gor kha bas mes rgyal gyi mtha' mtshams bod sa khul du btsan 'dzul byas te skyid rong dang / gnya' nang / rdzong dga' sogs ham bzung byas/ de rjes rim bzhin gzhis ka rtse bar 'ongs nas bkra shis lhun po'i dngos rdzas gal che yongs rdzogs phyogs/ gtsang dang stod khul gyi mi dmangs la mnar gcod tshad med btang / ra lug mang che ba phyogs/ de'i skabs 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po chan lung gis mes rgyal mtha' mtshams brtan srung dang / bod mi dmangs rnams dmag 'khrug gi sdug bsngal las skyob phyir snga rjes su bod du dmag dpung mngasas / lhag tu chu byi (spyi lo1792)lor/dmag dpon chen po h+phu khang yon sogs 'go dmag chig khri bdun stong lhag tsam bod du 'ongs/ rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs ldan zhing dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pa/ dmag don la byang chub pa'i dmag dpon 'di nyid lha sar 'byor 'phral gzhis rtse brgyud rdzong dga' dang / skyed grong sogs nas gor dmag la phar rgol byas te phas rgol gor kha ba'i 'go dmag gtso bo gsum dang / dmag mi dgu brgya lhag tsam tshar bcad/ bod kyi sa cha yongs rdzogs tshur blangs/ mthar gor kha btsan 'dzul pas mgo btags zhus te bkras lhun dgon pa'i gna' rdzas dang / zhwa dmar sprul sku'i bza' zla tshe dbang lha mo dang bu mo tshe dbang sogs krung gor rtsis 'bul zhus/ krung go'i mnga' khongs bod sa khul du btsan 'dzul rigs mi byed pa'i khas len zhus/ tshin gong ma'i dmag dpung gis btsan 'dzul pa mthar bskrad de mes rgyal sa mtshama~X sra brtan btang ba de ni lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa zhig red/
de nas h+phu khang an sogs nas rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang /bka' shag paṇa chen rin po che'i dza sag sogs la bka' gros gnang ste bod kyi las don byed phyogs skor la rtsa 'dzin don tshan nyer dgu gtan 'bebs gnang / de'i nang tā la'i bla ma dang / hu thog thu'i yang srid gtan 'khol byed skabs gser bum dkrug dgos pa'i lam srol gsar du gtod/ de bzhin bod kyi dpon rigs che chung rnams bsko gzhag dang gnas spar sogs byed phyogs skor dang / bod sa gnas kyi dmag dpung sgrig gzhi'i skor/ bod kyi nor srid dang / dpya khral/ khral 'ul lam lugs skor sogs gtan 'bebs zhib cing phra ba mdzad/de rjes chin krung dbyang srid gzhung ni rlung gi dbus su gnas pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur stabs dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i ngan grabs bshams/ de bzhin bod kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'gal ba'ang ha cang rnyog 'dzing dang / dza drag rno ngar can du gyur/sa stag ( spyi lo 1878 ) lor/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho po tā la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol chog pa zhes bod bzhugs am ban brgyud gong ma kong zhur gser snyan sgron/ gong ma chen po'i bka' phyir phebs ltar sa yos ( spyi lo1879)lo'i zla6tshes 13nyin gser khrir mnga' gsol/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir 'khod rjes bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i gnas su gyar ba ste btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod ljongs 'di nyid mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong phyir gsang nyul btang ba tsam ma zad/mngon sum 'dzems med kyis bod du btsan 'dzul byas/ btsan phru) ring
lugs pa'i lkog g.yo ngan jus de rigs rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtshos rim gyis gsal bar mkhyen rtogs byung bar brten rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug( spyi lo1928)lo'i dgun dus su ma bskul dang blangs kyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar bca' bzhugs mkhan po blo bzang pa sangs dang / de rjes pe cing g.yi ho kung ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas rnam gnyis nan cing du mngags/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la btsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu ba'i rnam pa mtshon par byas/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung nas kyang bod kyi gnad don thag gcod byed phyogs skor la dri ba don tshan brgyad bton/ de nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta ( spyi lo1930)lor mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas nan cing du ba ca' sdod bod kyi spyi khyab 'thus mir bsko gzhag stsal/ lcags lug (spyi lo1931 )lor/ 9 tshul khrims bstan 'dzin sogs mngags gtong thog nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang dngos su btsugs pa sogs la brten dbyin ji patsan rgyal ring lugs pa ngo tsha kha skyengs kyi gnas su lhungs te bal por ngan skul gyis mtha' mtshams su zing cha yang yang bslangs rkyen gor bod dbar slar yang dmag 'khrug langs/chu bya (spyi lo1933)lo'i zla10tshes 30nyin rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sku gshegs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing khyi ( spyi lo1934)lo'i zla8par go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong rma'o sung bod du gtong gnang mdzad/khong lha sar 'byor rjes rtse pho brang du mdzad sgo gzab rgyas tshugs/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog la88hu go hwang hwa phu tse yon jo tā tre zhes snon cho lo dang / 33snang kri'i 'ja' sa dang tham kha stsal/ gser gdung gi zhal 'debs
kyang gang legs phul/de nas shing khyi ( spyi lo1934)lor/ drung rtsis tshogs 'du che mos go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron pa ltar rwa sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes la srid blon dang / glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug la srid blon las rogs bsko gzhag stsal/ rwa sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes mes rgyal la dga' zhen che bas dbyin ji btsan rgyal pas slar yang kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang par ngan skul gyis srid bsgyur byed pa'i lkog g.yo bshams/lcags 'brug ( spyi lo1940)lo'i zla1tshes14 ( yig tshags 'ga' zhig tu tshes30zhes 'khod ) nyin/ rtse pho brang chen por twā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma khri bzhugs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byed pa'i ched du bod sog u yon lhan khang ge u yon krang 'u krung shin hin rdu brgyud bod du mngags 'byor byung / 'u u yon brang lha sar 'byor skabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas sne len dang bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/gong du smos pa'i lo rgyus kyi dngos yod gnas tshul de rnams kyi thog nas rgya bod mi rigs kyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dang / bod 'di krung go'i mnga' khongs bsnyon med yin pa'i ra 'phrod gsal po thub/ 'dzam gling thog gi rgyal khab mang che ba dang / gzur gnas skye bo kun gyis kyang lo rgyus kyi don dngos 'di dag khas len mdzad dang mdzad bzhin pa yin/ 'on kyang btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / log spyod shog khas bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i ched du lkog g.yo bshams pa tsam ma zad/ mngon sum 'dzems med kyis drag po'iri btsan 'dzul yang byas/ dper na u ru lha1 btsan
rgyal ring lugs pas rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu sprel ( spyi lo 1872) lo nas bzung snga dzes su dmag dpon phu rje war si ci dang / lo'o phu blo pu si ci sogs shin cang brgyud byang ngos nas nag chur slebs/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang bod rigs mi dmangs kyis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs mtsho sngon du phyir bros byas/ yang me byi ( spyi lo1876)lor/ u ru su'i ngo dpon nyi'i zer ba bod du bskor nyul yong bar bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ u ru su btsan rgyal ring lugs pa ni g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bar byang pa che bas u ru su'i mi dngos su bod du yong thabs dka' bar brten thabs lam gzhan gyi sgo nas bod kyi nang srid la the byus byed pa'i lkog ngan brtsams/ u ru sus pu li g.ya' tha ( phyi sog ) btsan bzung byas rjes nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs la dad gus byed pa'i phyi gos gyon te nang pa'i dgon pa nyams gso dang / chos byed skyes bu rnams la rgyab skyor byed pa'i g.yo thabs la brten nas nang sog dang bod khyur mid gtong rtsis byas/de'i dus phyi sog gi gzhon nu nyis brgya lhag tsam gdan sa chen po bzhir grwa pa byed par 'ongs/ skabs de dang bstun te rdo rje g.yib zer ba'i u ru su'i nyul ma de'ang bod du 'byor/ kho pa 'bras spungs dgon par phyi tshul du rab byung tshul ldan gyi ngang tshul bstan te bsdad/ de nas rim bzhin mngon sum 'dzems med kyis krung go'i nang srid la the byus byas te bod 'di nyid mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i spyod ngan rab dang rim pa spel/ de bzhin dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod 'di nyid mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i ched du sbe 'ar zer ba sogs bod du btang nas g.yo spriswā sbyor ba mang tsam spel ba ma zad/ snga rjes su mngon sum 'dzems
med kyis bod la drag po'i btsan 'dzul byas/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung rgyal gces ser skya dpon rigs khrag dang / bod mi dmangs kyis mes rgyal mtha' mtshams dang rang nyid kyi pha yul srung skyob byed ched ba ca na rbo rma rgyal gces kyi dar cha mthon por bsgrengs te dbyin ji btsan rgyal ze ro (ru ga/ 4 par phar rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ deng skabs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i rgyugs khyi zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan gyis kyang 〈bod kyi chab srid rgyal rabs 〉 zhes ja chi deb cig brtsams te dpo/ra nag phyin ci log pa'i g.yo thabs la brten nas bod sger btsan yin khul dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung rim pa dang bod sa gnas ni mchod yo na sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba yin zer ba sogs kyi gtam 'chal mi nyung ba zhig smra ba de ni stong sems de nyid 'grub pa'i re ngan bcangs pa zhig rang red/ 'on kyang lo rgyus kyi rtsibs stong 'khor lo mdun du bskyod pa de log spyod kyi stobs shugs gang 'dra zhig gis kyang 'gog thabs med pa zhig yin/rlabs chen krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og rgyal yongs sa gnas mang che bar bcings 'grol btang rdzes spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 10tshes 1nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyab khab dngos su dbu brnyes/mtha' yas nam mkha'i dbyings su skar lnga'i dar dmar lhab lhub tu g.yo ba dang / mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs kyis dga' spro'i skad gsang 'brug sgra ldir ba ltar bsgrags/ de nas bzung dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar pa'i gsar brje rtsa ba'i cha nas mjug bsgril ba dang / mes rgyal mi rigs khrag gi mi dmangs yangs shing rgya che ba dang / bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi gsar brje'i bgrod lam thog gom stabs chen pos ma〉spya nas
mdun du skyod bzhin par gnas so/ /'on kyang mes rgyal lho nub mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i bod sa mtho'i thog gi mi rigs khrag gi mi dmangs da dung sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las mi thar bar nyin mtshan kun tu bde skyid kyi nyi ma bod du gang myur shar thub pa'i re 'dod skom pa chu 'dod ltar byed bzhin du gnas/ tang dang mo'i kru'u zhis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod skyod byas te skam sa chen po yongs su bcings 'grol dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis zhi ba'i thabs lam brgyud bod mi dmangs rnams gang myur bcings 'grol thob ched sngon du dge ba'i bshes mnyen chen po shes rab rgya mtsho mchog mtsho sngon brgyud bod du gtong gnang mdzad mod/ nag chu khar 'byor skabs bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pas drag shugs la brten nas phyir bskrad/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gis kun khyab rlung 'phrin brgyud krung dbyang srid gzhung gis bod du 'dzin pa'i srid byus dang / gang myur ngang btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs mtha' dag mthar skyod btang ste mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang tshur log dgos pa'i dril bsgrags yang yang mdzad pa smos ci/ dge stag rin po che bod kyi mtho rim mi snar dge bshad sdig bkrol byed par gtong gnang mdzad/ lcags stag ( spyi lo 1950 ) zla 1tshes 24nyin mdo smad mnga' khongs chab mdor 'byor te 'brel yod khrag la gang ci'i go bskon slob gso gnang ba ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho zhal mjal te bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong lugs skor gros mol zhu dgos pa'i re ba bton stabs btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / bod kyi mtho rim lots+tsha spyod pa dngangs skrag dang 'khon 'dzin cig car du 'char te lcags
stag (spyi lo 1950) lo'i zla 8tshes 22nyin/ dbyin ji'i gsang nyul h+phu sprus dug sbyor gyis bkrongs/de nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdo bcings 'grol gtong ba'i 'go tshugs/ bod lcags stag (spyi lo 1950)lo zla 10tshes 15nyin chab mdo khul yongs bcings 'grol btang / dbyin ji'i so pa h+phu thā sogs gson bzung byas/ chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ba des dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / hin rdu log spyod shog khag bod kyi mtho rim log spyod shog khrag sogs la rdung rdeg tsha nan phog stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid blon dgongs pa mi zhu thabs med kyi gnas su gyar/lcags stag (spyi lo 1950)zla10tshes 8nyin/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos srid kyi gtso 'gan yongs su bzhes/ dus der phyi nang gang cir dka' ngal dang rnyog 'dzing che ba'i dus la babs/ skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa nang khul du'ang 'thab rtsod rno ngar ches cher gyur/ rgyal gces dpon rigs rnams kyis mes rgyal la brten nas zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob thabs byed pa 'di ni yang dag pa'i lam phyogs kho na nyid yin zhes brjod/ mthar rgyal gces btsan rgol gyi stobs shugs rnam par rgyal te krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhu rgyu dang / bod nas 'thus mi btang thog zhi ba'i gros mol byed rgyu thag gcod mdzad/ lcags yos ( spyi lo 1950) lo'i spyi zla 2par/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ thub bstan bstan dar/ thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas 'thus mir bsko ga'ag gnang ste pe cing ñtsā 5bskyod/
krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rlis kus hān dang / krang cing u/ brang go hwa/ sun kri yon bcas dang mdza' brtse'i gros mol yun ring gnang ste lcags yos ( spyi lo 1951 ) zla 5tshes 23nyin/ pe cing ching kun pho brang du krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams nas bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas 'tshogs/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba'i skor gtan 'bebs gsal zhing gsal ba gnang ba ma zad/ bod sa gnas nang khul gyi lo rgyus don gnad khag la'ang thag gcod yang dag pa gnang bar brten tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs ser skya dpon rigs dang / mi dmangs yongs nas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis brtsi bkur mtha' gcig tu zhus pa des btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brang pa rnams kyis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i lkog g.yo ngan byus mtha' dag thal ba'i rdul du brlabs te bod kyi mi rigs khrag gi mi dmangs rnams btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / log spyod shog kha'i 'ching thag las bkrol te krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dro skyid ldan pa'i mi rigs khyim tshang chen po'i nang du tshur log tang krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi khe dbang longs su spyod thub pa dang / bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/rig gnas slob gso'i bya gzhag sogs dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar nyin bzhin gong du3 (phel/ bde skyed phun sum tshogs pa'i nyi 'od shar ri'i phrag pa'i rtse

bod kyi gna' rabs kyi yul srol bzang po kha btags sam mjal dar gyi skor rags tsam gleng ba/rang rgyal ni mi rigs mang po yod pa'i rgyal khab cig yin la/ spun zla mi rigs so so la/'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang yul gom gshis lugs kyang mi 'dra ba mang zhing / deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs khag phan tshun dbar sngar dang mi 'dra bar 'gro 'ong byed pa'i skabs su rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang yul srol la gzhigs te bsu skyel zhu bzhin yod/bod rigs la cha mtshon na skyed sdug gi bya ba gang zhig byung rung / rang nyid kyi rnam dkar lhag bsam mtshon byed mja'achi dar dkar gtsang zhig 'bul srol yod pa de ni gna' rabs kyi yul srol/ bzang po zhig yin pas spun zla mi rigs dang grogs po phyi rgyal ba tshos kyang ha cang mnyes po gnang ba ma zad/yul srol bzang po de nyin bzhin khyab gdal du 'gro bzhin gnas/ der brten/ deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi blo ldan skye bo mang pos kha btags ni dus gang zhig dang / yul gang zhig nas dar min skor gleng mol mang tsam gnang zhing / lhag par du bod rig pa mkhas can gyi mtshan 'dzin pa la las kha btags ni sog yul nas dar lugs skor mang tsam gsungs/ de'i phyir kha btags ni bod rigs rang gi rig gnas shig yin nam/ yang na mi rigs 38

khyung po steng chen khyung dkar g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling /dgon 'di ni steng chen grong brdal gyi khongs su gtogs pa dang / rdzong gi nub rgyud ri ldebs su gnas/ rab byung dang po'i lcags glang ( spyi lo 106 1 )lor khyung po shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab/ sngon du khong gi gdung rgyud skor mdo tsam brjod na/ ches snga ba'i dus su yul me tog tshal du khyung chen babs shul du shel ltar gyi sgo nga gsum byung ba las ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i khye'u gsum 'khrungs pa de la khyung po zhes 'bod/ khye'u che ba la 9lta khyung dang / 'bring ba khyung thog la 'bar/ chung bar dmu khyung rgyal zhes mtshan gsol/ de gsum gyi nang nas chung ba dmu khyung rgyal gyi gdung rabs grol tshul skor bkod pa/ dmu khyung rgyal la sras stag sgra dun gtsug dang /dpal gyi ger ti/ khyung bza' ye shes mtsho rgyal dang gsum mo/ / khyung bza' de 'ang zhung rgyal po lig mi rgyal gyi btsun mor 'khod/ de bzhin sras gnyis so sor gdung rgyud 'phel ba la/ steng chen du byung ba'i rgyud pa ni sras che ba stag sgra dun gtsug gi gdung rgyud yin/ de'i sras gyer nam zur rtse/ de'i sras sdong rgyung ring mo dang stag la skyes gnyis/ sdong rgyung ring mo'i sras khyung sgom mu langs dang / khyung 'phags khra mo/ khyung sder sngon mo dang gsum yod/khyung sgom mu langs kyi sras khu byug de'i sras stag pa dang / zur dkar ba/72
khyung po steng chen khyung darkar pa]yung drung bstan rgyas gling /mdo bkra ba dang gsum yod/ stag pa'i sras myes tshab/ de'i sras ston pa 'bar dang / dam pa khyung sgom lam shes rab sgom/ dben pa ma lugs sam ston lug dam pa khyung dbus sam dad pa rgyal mtshan dang bzhi yod/ ston pa 'bar gyi sras ston thar/ de la sras drug yod pa ste ston sras dang / khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ston mnyan dam pa bang bkra/ dpon dge dpon dbus/ ston 'bum bcas so/ / sras de rnams kyi yum t+na rgya bza' yin pas/ rgya tsha spun drug ces mtshan snyan gang sar khyab/ de nas rgya tsha spun drug gi bye brag khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan la lha bla ma'i bka' lung bstan pa 'di ltar/ dbra dkar khyung po'i rgyud 'dzin pa/ / laṃ do khams smad du phebs par bgyis/ / bstan pa nyi zla 'char nub de/ / do dgong 'grib kyang sang nyin shar/ / sum glang khyim shod rngu rdzong gnas/ /khyad 'phags shel gyi rdzong dru ga mdun/ / gser nya mtshor 'khyil steng chen la/ / khyung po chags pa'i gdan sa yod/ / sa phyogs de ru phebs par bgyis/ / shes bya'i gter gyi chu bo 'khyil/ / 'gyur med ba dan brtan par gnas/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de nas khyung po shes rab rgyal mtshan rim bzhin steng chen du phebs/ yul 'di'i mnga' bdag rgya rje nyi ma 'brug grags zhes bya ba stobs dang mnga' thang che ba/ rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa 'ig yod/ des sangs rgyas gong ma'i zhal gdams dang rgyud gang la gzhigs kyang /nga yi bstan pa 'di dang gnas pa'i yul ni khyung po rang du yin pa dus la babs so dgongs te khyung po shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi phebs bsur ngo bcar zhus/ dus der khyung po rin po che khro rdo rma la bzhi'i tshur nang du phebs zin pa dang / rgya gtsug tor nyi ma 'brug gis rma yi khyung khri thang du khri brtsegs/ 73
phebs bsu rten 'brel dang bsnyen bkur zhabs tog rgya che gnang / khyung rin po che yang shin tu mnyes snang mdzad/ de nas gsol 'dren byas te rgya mkhar khams gsum dbang 'dus su spyan drangs so/ / de nas gong gi lung bstan bzhin gser nya mtsho la 'khyil ba 'dra zer ba de gnas 'di ru yin pa gsal por ra 'phrod de/ steng chen kha ru byon nas thog mar mdo sngags so sor dbye ba'i kun khyab gling dang / bstan rgyas gling phyag btab/ bstan rgyas gling ni 'dul dgon yin la de la rnam dag 'dul 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rab dang rim pa byon/ kun khyab gling ni sngags dgon yin pas rjes su tha yud wer zhi dang / do khung bla rabs bco brgyad kyi bla ma sogs ral pa thor cog can gyi rgyud pa zam mi chad par bstan pa spel zhing 'gro don mdzad/ /de nas rgya rje nyi ma 'brug grags kyis khyung dbus rin po cher zhus pa 'di ltar/ nga rgya yi bstan pa rgya yul du yod/ nga rang yul du 'gro dgos pas gdan sa 'di khyed kyi gzhugs gnas mdzod/ gser gzhong gang byin pa'i zhing chen 'di/ rgyal khyung khyed kyi babs gdan mdzod/ gong sngon nyag gi sa thang na/ / ( khri rdo sgang ri yar thang ) nga rgya dze gser sho 'phen sa yin/ / rgyal po khyed kyi babs gdan mdzod/ / blon la sa g.yar nyen le min/ / gser ru gsum mdo man chad dang / / chu gnyis 'dres sa yan chad 'di/ / ( chu mdo 'gag mchan ) rgya rgan nga yis nyos le min/ / rgyal po khyed kyi babs gdan mdzod/ / brag dmar me ri'i rdzong chen na/ / ( brag dmar ri 'dus yin zer ) bya khyung chen tshang la bzhugs 'dra'i sa/ / rgyal po khyed kyi bzhugs gnas mdzod/ / rdzong sa dang pho brang 'di na 'debs/ / zhes dang / rdza dkar ༵ ma'i chu 'a go de/ / chibs kyi rta chu blud sa mdzod/ / de tsho rgyal po'i
phyag tu bzhes/ / zhu ba'i mtshams sbyor 'di ltar phul/ / khyung dbus rin po ches bdag ni khyim spang gi btsun pa zhig yin pas yul mkhar mi sde 'go 'dzin ni bdag gis ma shes zhes gsungs/ gal srid khyed rgya yi yul mkhar khyung po la gsol ras bstsal tshe nga yi spun mched sras a brla dang nang chen grags pa gnyis zhang zhung khyung lung dngul mkhar la bzhugs bzhin yod pas/ bdag gis phyag rtags shig bskur la khyed kyis bang mi gnyis gtong gnang yod pa'i re 'dun gsungs/ de nas khyung dbus rin po ches phyag gri yu dkar ma de bskur gnang ba dang / rgya nyi ma 'brug grags kyis bang mi btang ba de gnyis kyis khyung a brla zhal mjal te phyag rtags dang gnas yig phul te gdan drangs par byon dgos pa'i gnas lugs rnams 'ib mor zhus pas/ khyung a brla yis zhal bzhes gnang ste khong dang bang mi gnyis lho lam brgyud mar byon zhing / khyung po steng chen gyi yul der dga' spro'i ngang phebs/ / de nas khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan dang nyi ma 'brug grags rnam gnyis kyis khyung a brla dang zhal 'dzoms gnang ba ma zad/ rgya nyi ma 'brug grags kyis sa thob dang sde thob yod tshad khyung a brla la phul nas rgya rje 'khor dang bcas rgya nag yul du phebs/ skabs der khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan dang a brla sogs yul sde'i ser skya yongs kyis phebs skyel gzab rgyas zhus /de rjes khyung shes rab rgyal mtshan mchog grub rtags rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan te lho rngul chu'i 'gram du phebs nas gshegs/ /de nas nang chen grags pa rgya nag tu phebs/ gong ma chen pos mjal 'phrad gnang / yar phyir log phebs rjes gong ma chen po'i bka' bzhin a brla'i gdan sa steng chen rang du mdzad/ rgyal khrims dang bon ltapas kyi
mtshan snyan 'brug sgra sa gzhi yongs su khyab/ de nas a brla mchog gis grub rtags rdzu 'phrul 'gran med kyi sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher spel/ mthar dgung lo drug cu re gnyis phebs te dgongs pa bon dbyings su gshegs/ rten du sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhengs/ /de nas a brla la lcam bzhi yod pa'i nang tshan 'dan bza' la sras khyung 'ig ye rgyal ba dang / dbang rgyal grub/ byang nang pa byang shes dang gsum las/ che ba bla ma khyung zhig ye rgyal ba yis rab byung gi sdom pa gtsang mar srung /khro bo dbang chen dang / phur pa la thugs dam mdzad/ mthu byin gyi nus pa me ltar 'bar ba byung nas bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya che spel/ dgung lo bdun cu'i steng du phebs skabs dgongs pa bde bar gshegs/ de nas rong mo za yi sras bso da nams rgyal mtshan ni sku'i mtshan dpe gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ gsung 'gro bar bka' btsan pa/ thugs la mngon shes mnga' ba'i mkhas btsun bzang po mtshan snyan grags shin tu che ba zhig byung / dgung lo gya gnyis la dgongs pa bon dbyings su gshegs/ de nas rong mo za yi sras drung chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni/ bon gyi gsung rab la mkhyen rgya che zhing / lhag par du rtag tu srid rgyal drel dmar sgrub pas mthu rtsal ha cang che ba dang / 'gro don 'phrin las rgya che mdzad/ dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis lor steng chen du gshegs/ de'i gdan sa rin chen rgyal mtshan dar gyis bzung / gsang gsum yon tan dang ldan zhing bon gyi bstan pa rgya che spel/ dgung lo zhe gnyis lor steng chen du dgongs pa bde bar gshegs/ de'i gdan sa g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gis bzung / mkhas grub 'di ni bon gyi rig pa'i gnas la sbyang pag n+tā zhing 'gro don rgya che mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga gnyis la phebs
skabs khyung po steng chen du dgongs pa rdzogs/ de'i gdan sa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis bzung / dag pa drang srong gi bstan pa 'dzin cing / mkhas btsun don ldan gyi mtshan snyan gang sar grags/ bgrang bya sum cu so bzhi lor dgongs pa bon dbyings su gshegs/ de'i gdan sa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bzung / gsang gsum yon tan ldan zhing gzhan rgyud rtogs/ / thugs dam gcod la mkhas pas 'gal rkyen sel/ / dgung grangs brgyad cu gya gsum thog steng chen du dgongs pa bon dbyings su gshegs/ de'i gdan sa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bzung / rkyen ngan bar chad che bas sku chung ngu'i dus steng chen du dgongs pa rdzogs/ de'i gdan sa lhun grub bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis bzung / yid 'phrog mdzes ma'i sku la gzi brjid ldan/ / rlabs chen 'khor lo gsum gyi rgyal bstan spel/ / zhes g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad thog steng chen du dgongs pa bon dbyings su gshegs/ de'i gdan sa dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyis bzung / sku tshe bar chad che bas sku chung ngu'i dus nas dgongs pa rdzogs/de nas skyes mchog yid ba'in rgyal ba gdan sar phebs/ skyes mchog 'di ni gsang gsum yon tan gyi mngon par mtho zhing / bon skyong bstan srung rnams dngos su 'khor/ snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs pa'i grub rtags mang po bstan/ de nas mthu dbang stobs ldan rgyal ba don grub byon nas bstan pa spel/ de nas khyung po bla chung blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes mkhas btsun dam pa 'di yis bstan pa 'gro don rgya cher mdzad do/ / de nas sprul pa'i sku mchog rgyal ba gnyis pa blo ldan snying po ni sum pa glang gi gyim shod du dbra rigs gdung las rab byung drug pa'i lcags byi ( spyi lo 1360)lor sku bltastalha/ rtsa
gsum lha dang bon skyong bstan srung thams cad 'khor zhing / mdo dri med gzi bajid sogs snyan rgyud bka' gter pod lnga bcu nga bzhi tsam gtan la phab/bstan 'gro'i don du mdzad rjes dpag med spel zhing khyung po steng chen kha ru rjes bzhag ge gsas khang bkra shis 'od 'bar zhes bya ba rmad byung ge gtsug lag khang thog brtsegs lnga yod pa'i nang theg pa bzhi bcu rtsa lnga'i sku cha tshang bzhengs/ khams chen nag phran pa zhes gser bris dang mdo dri med gzi bzad sogs gsung rab byin can mang po bzhengs gnang mdzad/ gzhan yang rmad byung grub pa'i rang rtags ngo mtshar ldan pa mang po bstan/ bgrang bya bzhi cu zhe bdun thog 'ja' gur dang me tog gi char pa babs bzhin dgongs pa bon dbyings su bde bar gshegs/ de nas khyung chen yon tan rin chen gdan sar phebs shing bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya che mdzad/ de nas khyung dkar gyi gdan sa khyung po a 'ji zhes bya bas 'dzin/ de nas khyung dkar gyi gdan sa rjes ma 'dzin mkhan khyung po rnam rgyal yin cing / mthu stobs byin rlabs nus pa che zhing / bstan srung brag btsan dmar po bran ltar 'khor zhes mdzad pa dang mthu stobs 'gran pa dka' ba zhig byung / de nas steng chen khyung dkar gyi gdan sa spyang be zhu blo bzang bya bas bzung / bstan srid dang 'gro don legs par bskyangs/ de rjes spyang tshang gi sras rim byon gyis lugs gnyis kyi bya ba bskyangs te gdan sa bzung / de'i nang nas spyang 'phags tshe dbang bstan rgyal nyid sku na chung dus rgyal sras dam pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin cing /rab tu byung nas grwa sa chen po g.yung drung gling du byon te mtshan nyid la sbyang brtson legs par gnang thog dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes/ bcu phrag rig pa~X gnas la gsan sbyong mthar phyin gnang ba ma zad/ skyabs mgon bla
ma rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas ngag lung dang man ngag yongs rdzogs zhus/ skabs der steng chen du gter chen bde chen gling pa byon nas gter sgrom khar bzhugs te gnas 'dir myur du dgon pa chags pa'i lung bstan dang byin rlabs rten 'brel mdzad/ de don bzhin skyabs mgon zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis tshe dbang bstan la sa gnas der dgon pa bzhings dgos pa'i lung bstan gnang ba bzhin steng chen stod du khyung dkar rgyu'i bla rabs rim byon gyi g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling dang / smad du khyung bla rabs bco brgyad byon pa'i gdan sa kun khyab gling zhes pa de gnyis gcig tu bsgril nas bla ma skyes chen dam pa gnyis kyi lung bstan bzhin sa gnas khyad 'phags can gter sgrom kha zhes pa der rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu khyi ( spyi lo 1862)lor dgon pa gsar spos mdzad/ rgya che la grwa pa mang ba dang mnga' 'og sde khrag dud grangs bzhi brgya lhag tsam yod/ de bzhin gtsug lag khang che chung brgya lhag tsam bzhengs/gtsang dgon sha stag la bsgyur te bshad sgrub sgom gsum gyi srol gtod de sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang / bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len la bsten te lo ltar sgrub pa tshogs chen thengs bco lnga 'tshogs dgos/ dus rtag tu skyes bu dam pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon nas khyung po gdan sa bar ma g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling zhes mtshan snyan gyi ba dan gangs can sa mtho yongs su g.yo bzhin gnas/ de nas mkhas grub g.yung grags pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang rten 'gyur spus legs rgyas par bzhengs/ dkar chag phyag dpe rgyas par brtsams te lung rtogs gshen bstan mi nub gong du 'phel/ de nas khyung sprul tshe dbang g.yung drung gis bon bstan sngar mus 'dzin pa'i skabs su rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu glang ( spyi lo 1913) lor rgya bod g.yulha 9'khrug
skabs dgon pa 'di mer bsregs te gter/ slar yang khyung ser sga sprul tshe dbang g.yung drung gis bajid chags kyi lha khang rgya che dang / sku gsung thugs rten gang mang bzhings te bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad/ de nas mkhan po bstan pa grwa sa g.yung drung gling nas mtshan nyid dge bshes kyi mtshan rtags bzhes te rang yul du phebs/ de nas rgyal ba sman ri'i mkhan chen nyi ma dbang rgyal dgon 'dir byon skabs bstan pa'i bdag po mkhan por mnga' gsol mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten mang po bzhengs nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya che spel ba bcas so/ /khyung po steng chen dgon 'dir dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs grwa pa brgya dang brgyad cu tsam dang / da lta bla ma dang mkhan po rgya mtsho nor bu dgung lo sum cu so gsum/ dbu mdzad 'chi med g.yung drung dang / bstan pa/tshul khrims bcas dang / dge bskos bsod nams bkra shis/ snying rje bstan 'dzin sogs grwa grangs drug cu re gcig tsam 'dug dgon par rgyun sdod grwa pa bcu bzhi tsam las med/ /nyin re'i byed sgo ni/ zhogs pa rtsa rlung gsol 'debs dang / sngon 'gro kha 'don/ de nas bsangs btang / gtor ma bdud rtsi chu rgyun dang / rtsis 'go bdun pa/ dzam lha/ lan chags/ bar mdo sogs btang / cho ga ni/smon lam mtha' yas dang / 'dus chog ( dbyar gnas skabs ) ma dkri/rnam rgyal/ mkha' klong mdos/ khro bo'i skor/ gshed dmar dang / khro bo/dbang chen/ bon skyong bcas yin/ /gnas ri'i skor/ rgyab ri brag dmar ri 'dus/ de'i gnas bdag rin chenā 'bar ba dang / g.ya sa su gzi yar sku/ mar sku/ gong rgyal/( srung
ma zhig ) mdun ri khyung po ri rtse drug /'tsho ba'i yongs khungs ni/ nye 'khor ye tha grong brdal la zhing 'brog khyim dud lnga brgya lhag tsam dang / mi grangs sum stong nyis brgya lhag tsam 'duggtso bo grong chog tu bskyod de 'tsho ba skyel dgos shing / nyin re sku yon mtho shos la sgor nyi shu dang / dma' shos la sgor lnga tsam 'bul srol 'dug /khyung po steng chen ri khrod 'di ni khyung dkar g.yung drung bstan rgyas gling gi shar ngos su gnas/ dgon de gnyis bar thag ha cang nye ba yod la/ ri khrod 'di yi lha khang ga'i rgya che la bzo bkod brjid chags ldan pa 'ig yod/nang rten gtso bo ni/ lha khang che mo'i dbus su smon lam rgyal mtshan dang /g.yas su me ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bcas kyi sku gdung yod la ston pa gshen rab kyi r+ya dzad pa bcu gnyis kyi zhal thang rnying ma zhig kyang 'dug /ri khrod 'dir dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs grwa pa lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa dang / da lta bla ma gnyis te lhun grub rgya mtsho dang / yon tan rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad bkra shis dbang 'dus/ ma dgon ni kong po rgyal ri dgon yin gsungs/ /nyin re'i byed sgo gtso bo ni/ zhogs pa bsangs dang gtor ma gtong dgos/ nyin dgung la yi dam snying po dang / dgong mo bkag skyong 'don dgos/ /lo re bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer gsum nas tshes sum cu bar cho ga bcu gnyis cha tshang 'don dgos/ bod zla lnga pa nas drug pa'i zla mjug bar rnam rgyal cho ga gtong dgos/ bod zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas tshepa stam cu

'jig rten na grags che ba'i phrang nag gi gdan sa rtse drug dgon skor/dgon 'di ni steng chen rdzong sa sgang shang gi khongs su gtogs/ rdzong nas rlangs 'khor 'gro lam 'argyud shar lho'i ngos su spyi le sum cu tsam bskyod tshe rtse drug dgon gyi ri gsham du slebs/ de nas ri'i nub ngos nas rta bzhon te chu tshod gnyis tsam ri steng du phyin na rtse drug dgon du 'byor/ dgon 'di'i khor yug gi yul ljongs ni ha cang mdzes la/ phyogs gang sa nas bya rgyal khu byug dang / byi'u chung 'jol mo sogs kyi gsung snyan sgrog cing / g.yas g.yon gyi ri lung mang por gling ge sar rgyal po dang seng lcam 'brug mo'i skor gyi gtam brgyud mang la/ gnas ri dang yul lha zhi bdag skor gyi bshad rgyun yang shin tu mang po yod/dgon 'di rab byung drug pa'i chu phyag ( 1 383 )lor sprul sku blo ldan snying pos phyag btab/ gnas 'di ni g.yung drung sems dpa' grangs las 'das pa'i sgrub gnas byin rlabs ca na dang / sum pa glang gi gyim shod dpal shel le rdzong drug gshen bstan dri med rnam par dag pa'i gling zhes grags pa dang /'dzam gling gi phyogs dbus gang sar gnas pa'i gnas chen lnga ste/ rgya nag chu bo gling chen la/ / ri bo rtse lnga mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ rgya gar rdo rje gling chen la/rtswa ra'i rtswa khang mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ yo rgyan pad ma gling chen du/ me tog 83
spang mdzes mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ sham bha la yi gnas mchog tu/ / ri bo bo lha mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ / kha ba can gyi ljongs smad du/ / shel le rdzong drug mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ / ma dang mkha' 'gro'i 'dus sa yin zhes 'khod pa ltar na gnas khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pa lung gsal por bstan/ yang rtse drug lhun po gtsug gi rtse/ / shel le rgyu skar gsang ba'i gnas/ / yar lang shel le rdzong drug la/ / rtse mo drug la mtshan drug yod/ / mdun rgyab gnyis la mtshan brgyad yod/ / dang po yid bzhin nor bu'i rtse/ / sbyin pa mthar phyin rtse mo thob/ / gnyis pa dri med shel dkar rtse/ / tshul khrims mthar phyin dri med thob/ / gsum pa mnyam nyid mthong ba rtse/ / bzod pa mthar phyin gnyis med thob/ / bzhi pa bsam grub dga' ba rtse/ / brtson 'grus mthar phyin sgyu 'phrul thob/ / lnga pa mi 'gyur g.yung drung rtse/ / bsam gtan mthar phyin g.yo med thob / / drug pa chen po tog chen rtse/ / shes rab mthar phyin rtse mo thob/ / mdun du mngon dga' seng ge rtse/ / shar gyi mdangs len mjug mthar phyin/ / rgyab tu mthong smon zla ba rtse/ / nub kyi zer bsdus spyod mthar phyin/ rtse brgyad rtse mo bcu gnyis ldan/ / gnyis su med pa'i 'bras mthar phyin/ / skal ldan bzhugs pa'i gnas su bzang / rgyab ri glang chen nyal ba 'dra/ / glang chen kha na nor bu yod/ / g.yas ri zla ba tshes pa 'dra/ / zla tshes mkha' la skar phran yod/ / g.yon ri seng ge mchongs pa 'dra/ / dung seng mgul na g.yu ral yod/ / ri rgyud dar dkar spel ba la/ / mañdzi'i steng na bum tshul yod/ / che rgyud gdan sa mi 'chug pa/ / bum pa dgos 'dod kun nas 'byung / / yid bzhin nor bu rgyun mi chad/ / bum lto g.yung drung bon gyis bslongs/ / zhes pa sogs dgon de gnas yul gyi khyad chos dang / phyi
nang gsang gsum gyi yon tan/ bstod pa tshig mang du brjod pa'o/ /dgon 'di'i mtha' bskor na ngo mtshar ldan pa'i bka' rtags dang rang byon du mas khengs shing / mdun gyi pha bong ri'i 'og tu rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo che'i zhabs rjes khru gang tsam byas pa zhig bzhugs/ da lta'ang dad ldan skye bo kun gyis dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ rgyab tu rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku'i rang byon dang / ston pa 'chi med gtsug phud kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs rjes/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar ba'i brda rtags la yi ge a dang ma'i rang byon/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i bzhugs khri'i thog la g.yung drung dang a yig rang byon/brag ri'i g.yon ngos su mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i sku'i rang byon sogs yod la/ khyad par du rtse drug gnas ri'i mdun gsham du dur khrod bsil ba gling gi dkyil zhes pa la thod pa bor chog dkyil 'khor dang / zur du rdo ba'i bam chen gan rgyal 'dra ba la/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong khros ma rtag tu gnas/gnas brgyad mkha' 'gro'i dbu brnyan mang po dang phyag rjes/ rdo pha bong ngos shig la sangs rgyas gling pas phyag mdzub kyis/ sgo gsum dag pa'i dge ba gang bgyis pa/ / khams gsum sems can rnams kyi don du bsngo/ / dug gsum bsags pa'i las sgrib kun byang nas/ / sku gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog ces yig gzugs legs po'i dbu can 'dam la bris pa ltar gshong 'bur dang ldan pa gsal ltam mer mjal rgyu yod/ de nas mda' rgyangasagang gi sar pha bong zhig gi ngos su yi ge kun gyi ma phyi ya ra kha sru a bcas kyi rang byon dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ pha bong bon ri'i ngos la bka' rtags zhabs rjes yig 'bru gsal ba/ mtha' bskor du khro bo gtso mchog mkha' 'gyings kyi sku'i rang byon/ yang sangs rgyas sman bla'i sku dbyi 5dkyil
