shes rab gyi rtsal dang ldan pa thu mi sam bho ṭa sogs la gser phye bre gang dang /gser gyi pa ṭa la sogs rig byed smra ba'i ston pa yod dbang 'phrog par byed pa'i dngos po dang bcas bskur te 'phags yul du 'gro dgos pa'i bka' phab/ de nas thu mi sam bho ṭa sogs lha sa nas zhal gyes te thag ring lam gyi dka' sdug la ma 'dzems par bal yul du 'byor/ bal po'i rgyal por dngos po phul bas tsha ba'i nad la mchod tu gyur pa sman ga bur dang / cu gang /tsan dan gyi chu la sogs pa gang zab gnang bas bde blag ngang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'byor/ de nas rgya gar gyi yul gru yongs la mtshan snyan gang sar khyab pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po bram ze li byin dang paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge la gser phye dang / gser gyi pa ṭa sogs rin bral dngos po grangs med phul te slob dpon du bsten/ bram ze li byin gyi drung nas yig rigs sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge'i drung nas sgra pa ṇi pa dang /ka la pa/ tsan+d+ra pa rnams kyi sa ris/ rtogs sla ba rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcosaspyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang bcas pa lo bdun ring rig pa rtse gcig tu sbyang ste mkhas pa'i rtse mor son/ thu mi sam bho ṭa ste bod phrug bzang po zhes pa'i snyan pa'i mtshan bzang thob/ des lalca la dpe mdzad de dbu can dang / wartu la dpe blangs nas dbu med kyi yig gzugs brtsams/ de nas bod du phebs khar sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos khag gi rgya dpe dang / 'dus pa rin po che'i tog mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dge ba bcu'i mdo la sogs pa rgya dpe rnams chabs cig tu bsnams phebs pa ma zad/ brda dag gsal bar byed pa'i sum rtags sogs bod la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams 100
te chos rgyal srong btsan sgam por phul/ rgya gar rgyal pos skyes lan bskur ba'i mdo sde dkon mchog sprin dang / dam chos pad ma dkar po/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs/ nor bu ke ru bcas bod du phyir bsnams phebs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos thu mi sam bho ṭa slob dpon du bsten nas lha sa pha bong khar lo gsum bzhi ring sku mtshams su bzhugs te bod yig sbyangs pa mdzad/thu mi sam bho ṭa la'ang bkur bsti dang / gzengs bstod yang mdzad ces snyan pa'i gtam de gang sar khyab/ /'on kyang deng skabs bod yig ga dus gsar gtod byas min dang /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sngon du bod yig yod min/ zhang zhung gi yi ge dang / rgya gar gyi yi ge bod yig dbar 'brel ba gang yod med skor la phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos brtag zhib dang / rtsod gleng gnang dang gnang bzhin yod/ 'o na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po gser khrir mi 'khod gong du bod la yi ge yod dam med ce na/ srong btsan gyi gong du bod la yi ge yod ces pa de ni bod kyi gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus yig rnying khag dang yongs su mthun pa zhig red/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ bod kyi chos 'byung deb ther khag dang / /bon gyi dpe rnying 'ga' zhig tu bkod pa gsham gsal/ chos 'byung me tog snying po sbrang rtsi'i bcud las 66bod kyi yi ge yang khri pe btsan po'i ring byung bar 'dod pa yang yodag zhes 'khod pa dang / yang bon gyi brda dag rin gter las 88gnam ri srong btsan yan la bod yul du yi ge med ces khungs ma dgag pa bya/ de ni mkhas pa chen po'i gsung yin kyang / ma brtag bab col tshig tu zad par nges/ rgyal rabs so gnyis bar du bon dar na/ yi ge med 101

dbon po sogs bon po rnams kyis mtshan la gnya' khri btsan po zhes btags te srid khrir mnga' gsol/ 'on kyang btsan pos bon po rnams kyi khe phan yongs su mtshon mi thub stabs sum pa'i bon a yong gis rgyal po bkrongs/bon po rnams kyis rgyal srid kha lo bsgyur bar brten gri gum btsan pos bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs nas bon por rdung rdeg shugs chen phos/ mthar lo ngam gyis thabs ngan sna tshogs la brten nas gri gum btsan po bkrongs/ lo ngam de'ang bon blon zhig gam bon po'i khe phan gyi tshab byed mi sna zhig yin pa gsal por mngon/ pu de gung rgyal dus su lo rgyus kyi bslab bya blangs te bon gyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ de nas khri thog rje btsan bar slar yang bon gyis chab srid bskyangs/ bod kyi rgyal rabs der ther dkar po las 6 sngon dus bod kyi rgyal po la sku bon bya ba zhig 'dug pa de mdun na 'don gyi tshod tsam yin ga zer/ mdun na 'don zhes bya ba ni rgyun du btsan po'i sku gam du bon chos 'don mkhan zhig la zer/ sku bon zhes pa'i las sne de btsan po'i sku bcar zhig yin/ de ni chab srid don chen khrag thag gcod skabs legs nyes kyi mo phywa phab nas thad kur srid kyi bya bar the jus byed mkhan bon po zhig yin gshis/ /de nas lha tho tho ri'i sku dus bod chu sprul ( spyi lo 333)sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod du dar/ dus der paṇ+ḍi blo sems 'tsho dang lo tsā ba li the si rnam gnyis kyis spang kong phyag rgya pa dang / mdo sde za ma tog sogs sku gsung thugs rten bsnams te bod la phebs kyang dus der bon po rnams dbang shugs che ba'i rkyen gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa dar spel gtong bar bkag 'gog shugs chen 'phrad de khong rnam gnyis phyir log phebs dgos byung / 106
'on kyang bon gyi bstan pa'i kha gtad du gnas pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs de bod du dar 'go tshugs/ de nas snga rjes su bal bza' khri btsun dang rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi pad+ma rnam gnyis bod du gdan drangs/ skabs der thang rgyal rabs dang bal po'i rgyal khab gnyis ka sangs rgyas chos lugs dar khyab che ba'i rgyal khab cig yin stabs rten gtso jo bo shākya mu ne dang jo bo mi bskyod rdo rdze sogs bod du gdan drangs te gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs/ sangs rgyas chos lugs pa'i stobs shugs je cher phyin/ skabs der chos dang bon gnyis phyi tshul du chos lugs grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i rnam pa mtshon yang don dngos thog de dag gis srid dbang gi stobs shugs khag gnyis kyi tshab byas te bon blon dang chos bon dbar gyi 'thab rtsod shugs cher phyin/ de nas bzung bon po rnams kyi dbang bsgyur gyi gnas bab der rtsa ba'i thog nas g.yo 'gul shugs che thebs/ mthar bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs te chos blon rnams kyis bod kyi srid dbang yongs su kha lo bsgyur/ bon gyi rig gnas sam gna' rabs bod kyi rig gnas rmeg med gtong ba'i ched du bon ñtsi dpe cha dang yig rnying mang po mer bsregs/ la la bsam yas kyi mchod rten nag po'i 'og tu sbas/ mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser por mngon pa ltar/ bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus la 'khyog bshad mang tsam byas pa ste/ thu mi sam bho ṭa ma byon gong bod yul kha ba can der yi ge rtsa ba nas med tshul dang / dus de nas bzung bod kyi shes rig lo rgyus 'go tshugs tsam yin tshul/ thu mi sam bho ṭa de nyid bod la bka' drin ji ltar che tshul sogs lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang yongs su mi mthun pa'i bshad tshul sna tshogs gang sar khyab/ don dngos thog thu mi ma 'khrungs gong mi lo stong phrag lhag tsam gyi sngon du bod na sna mang phun sum 107
tshogs pa'i bon gyi rig gnas dar khyab che zhing / gal srid bon gyi rig gnas de bod kyi gna' rabs rig gnas yin par khas ma blangs tshe rang cag gi mes po'i phul byung gi rig gnas khas ma blangs pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus cha mi tshang ba zhig bzos pa zhig rang red/ mdor na/ gong gsal gyi lo rgyus de'i thog nas bod la thu mi sam bho ṭa'i gong du bod yig yod bzhin du tshig thag bcad nas med zer ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni skabs de'i chab srid kyi dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i ched du yin pa gsal por mngon/ /'o na/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog thu mi sam bho ṭa zhes pa de yod dam med/khongagi mdzad rjes dngos de gang yin nam/ de la'ang deng skabs mkhas pa mang pos gzigs tshul mi 'dra ba byung zhing / phyi nang gi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi dgongs tshul du tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi yig rnying thog thu mi sam bho ṭa'i mtshan yang med pas don du lo rgyus thog yod dam med/ yang mkhas pa 'ba' zhig gis thu mi sam bho ṭa'i gong du bod la yi ge yod kyang de ni chos lugs thog ma gtogs khyon yongs la bed spyod thub pa'i yi ge ma yin gsungs/de'i thad rang nyid kyi lta tshul ni/ da lta rang res tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi yig rnying cha shas de'i thad thu mi'i mtshan 'khod med kyang bod kyi chos 'byung dang deb ther rab dang rim pa'i nang thu mi sam bho ṭa'i 'khrungs yul dang /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i blon po mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin lugs/ thu mi'i khyim rgyud sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal zhing gsal ba bkod yod stabs de dogs 'char gnang dgos don ci yang mi 'dug snyam/ 'o na/ thu mi sam bho ṭa'i mdzad rjes dngos de gang yin zer na/ 'jig rten thog gi dngos po gang zhig yin rung / med pa nas yod pa dang / cha mi tshang ba nas tshang ba/ 108
dma' rim nas mtho rim du 'phel rgyas 'gro ba de ni dngos po mtha' dag 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i chos nyid cig yin/ der brten bod yig de'ang 'a phel rgyas kyi dus rim de ltar zhig brgyud dgos pa ni smos mi dgos/ da yod khungs btsan gyi yig rnying khrag la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i dbye zhib byas pa ltar na/ gshen lo nyi shu lhag tsam ste mi lo nyis stong lhag tsam gong du gna' rabs kyi bod yig gsar gtod byas pa gsal por mngon/ 'on kyang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang mthun dgos shing / mkhas dbang kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos sum pa sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran mang po dbang du 'dus te bod sa sbrul lor ( spyi lo 633 )rgyal sa lha sar spos/ de nas bzung lha sa ni bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/rig gnas bcas kyi lte gnas su gyur/ srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi dang /dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs sogs gtan la phab/ khrims yig gsar bzo dang / legs nyes blang dor gyi tshad gzhi gtan la phab/ bstan bcos mang po bod yig tu bsgyur ba sogs mdzad pa rgya cher spel/ de bzhin thu mi sam bho ṭa sogs rgya gar la btang ste lañtsa dang / wartu/ na ga ra sogs kyi yi ge la dpyadagazhi mdzad de bod yig la kha skong dang legs bcos gnang zhes pa de skabs de'i lo rgyus dang dngos su mthun pa zhig red/ de gsal por bshad na/mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab khrag dang phan tshun 'brel gtugs che ba dang / dpal 'byor gong du 'phel ba/ bstan bcos mang po bod yig tu bsgyur dgos pa'i dgos mkho dang bstun ched bod yig la'ang legs bcos mi byed thabs med yin gshis/ thu mi sam bho ṭa sogs rgya gar du phebs/ rgya gar gyi yi ge sogs la spyang pa mthar phyin mdzad pa dang / bod yig la mkho ba'i sum cu pa dang / 109

'dzin pa dang / bar pa ni rgyal mkhar ba chod la zer gsungs/ rgyal mkhar ba ni mkhar ming ste dmu rdzong zhes pa de la go dgos/ 'di ni stod na yod pa'i ma brtsigs mkhar ba bzhi'i bye brag cig yin par 'dod/ sgo pa ni khyung lung dngul mkhar gyis mtshon pa'i yul sde de rnams la zer/ zhang zhung sgo pa'i sa khyon skor la/ srid pa rgyud kyi kha byang nang / shar smyug ma bu khur dang / byang 'jags ma glu len/ nub gnub mtsho'i gling / lho dom sgro nag po dang bzhi'i dbus su stod zhang zhung khyung lung dang smad sum pa yod par bstan/ gong gi sa rnams zhib gsal gyi dbye mtshams ni/ lho bal bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams su brag sprug bu khur dang / byang hor bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams su ling wing sgang ring / nub o rgyan dang bod mtshams su zhang zhung khri sde khyung lung / shar bod mtshams su sum pa glang gi gyim shod la zer zhes gsungs/ /gnyis/ zhang zhung sgo pa la phyis mkhas dbang mang pos sgo phug bar gsum du dbye ba 'di ltar phug pa ni/ grong khyung lung la sogs pa zer ba dang /bar pa ni rta sgos dang dwangs ra g.yu mtsho'i khul du go dgos/ sgo pa ni zhang zhung smad sum pa glang gi gyim shod khul du yin/ /gsum/ zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum skor bshad srol gzhan zhig ni/phug pa ni/ stod khyung lung gi yul la zhang zhung kha yug dang / zhang zhung dar ma'i yul/ spu rong yul 'bod pa de khyung pos bzung ba'i 'khor chen lnga yi dbus khyung lung dngul mkhar gyi yul sder go dgos/ zhang zhung bar pa ni/sta sgo dang dwangs ra g.yu mtsho ste zhang zhung rgyal po'i bla brag dang / bla mtsho yin zhes pa'i khul der go dgos/ sgo pa ni smad sum pa'i yul shod chen bco brgyad ñtsha ༵ gyal sum pa glang gi gyim shod la ngos 'dzin dgos/ shod chen
bco brgyad ni/ nag shod dang / sog shod/ lbi shod/ sum shod/ dkar shod/ dmar shod/ gnyi shod/ zla shod/ skyi shod/ yun shod/ dma' shod/'ja' shod/ stag shod/ 'dan shod/ gyim shod/ rma shod/ 'dre shod/nyag shod dang bcas so/ /mdor na/ zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum la bzhed srol mi 'dra ba khag gsu ma tsam byung rung / don du da lta nga tshos sngar lo rgyus thog tu 'ang zhung gi sa khongs dang chags tshul la brtags par gzhigs na/ zhang zhung phug pa ni ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'i 'khrungs yul rtag gzis/sa 'ol mo lung rings kyis gtsos pa'i zhang zhung kha yug dang / zhang zhung dar ma sogs da lta'i mnga' ris khul gyi yul sde yongs rdzogs su go dgos snyam/ /zhang zhung bar pa ni zhang zhung rgyal po'i bla brag bon gyi gnas ri gangs ri chen po lnga yi ya gyal sta sgo dang / bla mtsho/ dwangs ra g.yu mtsho gtso bor gyur pa'i khul der go dgos pa zhig 'dug de yang da lta nag chu sa khul nyi ma rdzong gi khul de yin/ gang lags she na/ da lta'ang khul 'dir 'om bu bsam gtan gling dang / dwangs ra g.yu bon dgon/ phyug tsho dgon/ sta sgo ser zhig dgon la sogs pa'i bon dgon dang / gnas ri/ bla mtsho mang du gnas/ khyad par du dwangs ra g.yu bun dgon gyi chags yul ni zhang zhung bar pa'i yul srid pa'i khams rnam par dag pa zhig red snyam/ mi lo sum stong tsam gyi sngon du g.yung drung bon gyi grub chen brgyad bcu'i thog ma mnga' bdag grub pa gshen bcu'i ya gyal g.yung drung bon gyi bstan par dka' drin lhag par che ba gnya' khri btsan po'i sras mu khri btsan po'i skabs su 'du gnas so bdun dang gsang sngags kyi sgrub sde so bdun btsugs pa'i nang ga lha 7gangs

por rtogs/ des na rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis kyi bye brag gangs can gyi gna' rabs ru chen bzhi yi ya gyal zhang zhung gi sa khongs ni/ gangs ti se dang / mtsho mi pham/ spos ri ngad ldan/ khyung lung dngul dkar sogs da lta'i mnga' ris kyi sa khongs yongs rdzogs dang / de bzhin rdzong dga' dang /mnga' ris gung thang / mang yul/ sa dga'/ zang zang lha stod khul gyi yul sde mang po/ de nas zang zang lha brag gi shar ngos nas thad drang pa'i drum gyi stag tshal dang / 'dam gzhung / gnyan chen thang lha/ nag chu rdzong / sbra chen rdzong / khyung po steng chen rdzong / mnga' ris sger rtse dang mtsho chen rdzong / shar phyogs su thad drang pa'i nyi ma rdzong dang / mtsho gnyis don gcod khang /dpal mgon rdzong / shan rtsa rdzong / snye rong rdzong sogs stod mnga' ris nas smad chab mdo steng chen byang khul sa cha mang po zhig gna' rabs zhang zhung gi mnga' 'og yin pa gsal por mthong thub/ mdor na/ gna' rabs lo rgyus thog zhang zhung sgo phug bar gsum gyi sa khongs ni ha cang che bas zhang zhung khri sde zhes grags che bar gyur/ dus der rig gnas dang / dpal 'byor/ bon chos/ dmag shugs sogs dar khyab stobs shugs che ba'i rgyal phran zhig yin/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya che spel bas bon gyi bstan par gnod 'tshe nges gtan zhig phog stabs zhang zhung gi rgyal po lig mig skyas bod du ngo log de rjes srong btsan sgam pos zhang zhung bod kyi mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ 'on kyang deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pa 'ga' zhig gis zhang zhung zhes pa ni gangs can yul gyi gna' bo'i rus tsho bzhi yi ya gyal dang / bod kyi rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis kyi bye brag cig min par zhang zhung gi mi dang / zhang zhung gi skad yig zhang zhung gi rig gnas zhes ha lam 159

snyan du bon zhes dang / mdo gzer mig nang thugs su gsol zhing snyan du bon zhes dang / dar rgyas gsal sgron du bon ni snyan du bon pas zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir bon gyi go don skabs su gong gi li yul gyi yig rnying dang bon dpe gnyis po'i phyi'i tshig sgrub kyi grub stangs dang nang don gnyis ka mthun par byung ngo lta ( bon sgo deb grangs brgyad pa'i shog grangs 14)zhes dang / yang bon zhes pa gyer la go dgos zhes/ bon gzhung nang snga dus snang gshen gyi bon la gyer zhes pa mthong zhes 'khod/ 〈zhang bod lo rgyus ti si'i 'od 〉las/ 64deng dus su ston zhes pa'i tshig 'di ni yongs grags shig tu gyur yod cing / tshig 'di'i 'byung khungs rnal ma ni bod skad kyi brda rnying 8bzlas pa'am 9 de'i brjod tshig 6 bon pa 9 ste 8 bzla ba ga zhes pa'i don la 'jug cing / ming de skad du grags pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gna' dus su sngags bzla ba'am de 'brel gyi cho ga dang rim 'gro byed pa la 6 bon : zhes dang / de ltar byed mkhan gyi gang zag de la 6 bon po 〉 zhes pa'i tha snyad chags 'dug lta ces gsungs/ mdor na/ tshad ldan dpe rnying du ma las lungs drangs te bon zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i go don la 'grel bshad dang mkhas pa so so'i 'dod tshul mang po gsungs pa des bon la zhib 'jug gnang skabs blo sgo 'byed rgyur phan pa chen po yong nges yin pa gsal por mngon/ /gong gsal gyi 'grel pa de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te zhib par brtags na/ bon zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i go don ni 'di ltar te/ bon la zhang zhung skad du gyer dang / bod kyi skad du bon/ de'i go don ni/ bzla ba'am bzlas/ rna bar thos pa/ mi g.yo ba/ dbyings nyid bdal ba'i klong / stong pa ma yin pa sogs la go dgos pa ni gsal por rtogs/ bon zhes pa'i ming 170
de 'dod rgyal gyis btags pa zhig ma yin par/ rjes grub don ldan pa zhig yin pa smos ma dgos cing / rang re kha ba can gyi mi rnams kyis chos lugs ru grub mtha' khrag gi ming 'dogs skabs ming de'i don snying la do snang ha cang chen po byed pa ni/ dper na/ rnying ma ba dang / bka' gdams pa/ bka' brgyud pa/ sa skya ba/ dge lugs pa sogs lta bu'o/ ming de dag thos pa tsam gyis chos lugs grub mtha' de rnams kyi khyad chos dang 'dod tshul gsal po rtogs thub/ rang res gsal po mthong thub pa zhig la bon zhes pa'i tha snyad de zhang zhung gi skad ma yin par bod kyi tha snyad rnal ma zhig red/ der brten bod kyi bon po rnams kyis zhang zhung gi gyer gyi chos lugs par bon po zhes phar btags pa gsal po shes thub/ zhang zhung gi skad du gyer zhes pa'i tha snyad de'i go don ni gshen te dge sgrub la go dgos zhes gsungs/ de ltar na zhang zhung pas rang nyid kyi chos lugs 'di la dge sgrub kyi chos lugs zhes ming btags/ da lta yang klu phug dgon dang / steng chen dgon/ rtse drug dgon sogs kyi bon po rnams kyis bon zhes pa de zhang zhung skad gyer yin pa ngos 'dzin mtha' gcig tu gnang zhing / hor sbra chen dang / khyung po steng chen sogs kyi deng skabs lo rgyus smra ba po mang pos ston pa gshen rab mi bo che bod du ma phebs gong bod la bon po'i chos lugs med pa kho nar ngos 'dzin gnang / /'di ni don dngos dang yongs su 'gal ba zhig red snyam/ gangs lags shes na/ 〈legs bshad rin po che'i gter mdzod 〉las/ 88ston pa bod du byon dus bod kyi bon po rnams la lha gsol ba 'dre bkar ba yug phud pa'i lung phog ༷ lta (shog grangs 161 ) ces gsungs/ tshig pa)phru thog
nas ston pa gshen rab bod du ma byon gong bod du bon po yod pa ni gsal por bstan/ bon gyi yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu gnya' khri btsan po'i sngon du bod la rgyu yi bon dar yod ces gsungs/ de bas gal che ba zhig la chab mdo kha rub kyi sa 'og nas lo ngo bzhi stong lnga brgya tsam song ba'i gna' rdzas mang po thon pa de dag gis skabs der lha mchod byed mkhan gyi chos lugs zhig gnas yod pa'i dpang rtags byed thub/ gong gsal de rnams ni lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang yongs su mthun pa zhig red snyam/ da dung rang res shes dgos pa zhig la/ bod kyi deb ther dang chos 'byung gal che ba tshang mar gcig mthun gyis bkod gsal du gnya' khri btsan po spo bo'i yul nas bod kyi yul dbus su byon skabs bon shes pa can bcu gnyis kyis mjal te gnya' bar khri byas nas gdan drangs pa las gnya' khri btsan po zhes mtshan gsol zer/ gong gsal de dag thog nas gnya' khri btsan po'i gong bod du bon po'i chos lugs gnas yod pa gsal po rtogs thub/ mdor na/ bon zhes pa'i tha snyad der 'grel bshad 'dra min gnang yod kyang don du bon zhes pa'i tshig de chos lugs grub mtha'i thog tu sbyar na mi g.yo ba dang / stong pa ma yin pa/ dge ba'i don sgrub bcas la ngos 'dzin na don dngos dang mtshungs shing / gong du smras pa ltar/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' khag gi ming yang thos pa tsam gyis de dag gi khyad chos dang / 'dod tshul gang yin gsal por rtogs thub/ de bzhin bon po rnams kyis rang nyid kyi chos lugs de khyad du 'phags pa dang / kun las rnam par rgyal ba zhig yong ched chos lugs de dag la mi g.yo ba ste brtan zhing 'gyur ba med pa dang / stong pa ma yin pa ste nang don phun sum tshogs pa/dge ba1 ltas pa ste dge ba'i las kho na sgrub mkhan zhes brjod pa de ni rang cag
